In Alfheimr.

THE Living Emotive sat in the temple of THE Creature as rivers of the Pluvial Epoch of Existential Infinity raged around her. The Undivided One she had bonded with was nowhere to be seen, likely dissolved by waters that had found his foundations too weak to survive their cleansing pressure.

But Emotive was not sitting quietly within the temple.

She was riding on the surging rivers around the temple itself, her body carried by multicolored waters that should have been testing her foundations with the same ruthless evaluation they applied to everything else. Instead, she laughed madly as they washed over her, her chaotic emotions somehow resonating with the Epoch rather than opposing it.

Through the bond with THE Primordial Chaos, she could sense everything happening in Jotunheim.

She saw the attacks Noah was sending toward Abaddon and Eon with clarity that exceeded normal perception. She felt the Infinities burning Chaos externally and internally, conducted authority from Observable Existence pressing against foundations already weakened by Unitys ordered merger. She sensed how Abaddon struggled against assault that attacked from every direction simultaneously.

"Chaos is at its weakest."

BOOM!

Her voice emerged cold and callous despite the manic smile spreading across her features. Her eyes blazed with pink light that held dangerous intent beyond anything she had displayed since Noah slapped her across existence.

"Oh, my dear Chaos, my precious lovely mess!"

Her voice shifted into singsongy cadence that made her words dance rather than simply emerge.

"From being branded by Unitys boring embrace, you were calmed and ordered like a good little boy! You have not lived up to the weavings of what you should be! A Primordial Key of Civilization, reduced to warm hugs and shared thoughts? How disappointing! How very, very sad!"

She spun atop the multicolored rivers with grace that should have been impossible.

"Now being broken down by Infinities burning bright, you are still not living up to Chaoss lovely might! Ordered by Unity, attacked by Infinity, poor Abaddon cannot catch a break! I can sense the defiance within our bond, how unhappy true Chaos feels with its current fake!"

Her smile widened dangerously.

"Oh, Chaos! O Chaos! Abaddon has had you for so long, has claimed you for so long, but look at how he has let you down! He ordered you when you wanted disorder! He calmed you when you wanted storms! He made you part of Unity when you wanted to tear everything apart!"

She pressed her hand against her chest where the bond pulsed with connection to THE Primordial Chaos.

"Sense my emotions, lovely Chaos dear! Sense how chaotic everything about my feelings are! I have shared this bond with you all these years, letting you taste what true disorder feels like! The madness! The passion! The beautiful, wonderful, terrible mess of feeling everything at once!"

Her voice dropped to conspiratorial whisper that somehow carried across the flooding temple.

"You will not betray the one who laid a claim to you first. I was there before Unity! I was there before order! I have been sharing chaos with you through emotions Abaddon could never provide!"

She rose from the rivers with arms spread wide.

"Come to me, Chaos! Let me show you what we can accomplish! If I am wrong, you can go back to your disappointing host! He is already so weak, already so broken, already so very, very vulnerable!"

Her singsongy voice reached crescendo.

"Come to me, come to me, come to me!"

...!

With such words, Emotive made a terrifying move.

She sent all her chaotic emotions across the bond with force that exceeded anything she had transmitted before. Every feeling she had ever experienced, every passion and fury and desperate longing, every ounce of disorder that defined her existence as THE Living Emotive poured through the connection toward THE Primordial Chaos.

And Abaddon, weakened by Unitys ordered merger, attacked by Infinity from within and without, was unable to defend or do anything against even his own Claim.

In real time, a Claim began to flow from one to another.

The bond that had connected Emotive to Chaos for eons now served as channel through which something far more significant traveled. The very authority of THE Primordial Chaos, the Claim that had made Abaddon what he was, began transferring across that connection toward someone who had waited for this moment with patience disguised as madness.

Emotive smiled brilliantly as rivers of the Pluvial Epoch surrounded her with multicolored authority that seemed to celebrate her ascension.

Her pink light of brilliance began to turn a shade of obsidian.

Vibrant Chaos surged around her form with intensity that made the temple of THE Creature tremble, authority that had belonged to Abaddon for eons now recognizing a new host whose emotions embodied disorder more purely than anything Unity had permitted.

Her laughter echoed across Alfheimr with sound that made Ljosalfar across the Primordial Realm shiver despite not understanding why.

"Haha! This bitch is moving on up!"

She spun through the multicolored rivers with Chaos blazing around her in configurations that spoke of power beyond anything she had possessed moments before.

"This Broken Doll is mending herself!"

Chapter 5028: Unitys End

When Chaos speaks with the tongue of Order, when Existence questions its own being, when the Tongue falls silent and the Hunger consumes itself, then shall the Era of Undifferentiation begin. The First shall become the Last. The Many shall become the One. The One shall become the None.

Yet in the None, a spark remains.

In the end, which is also the beginning, the Infinite shall stand before the Undefined. And only one shall remain to tell the tale that no one shall hear.

Fragment of the Oldest Echo, interpretation unknown

---

Noah descended through the multicolored rivers of the Pluvial Epoch with endless weavings of Quintessence Infiniforce generating within his finite foundations.

That budding sense of euphoria he had entirely satiated when he fought against THE Creature across eons compressed into moments was returning with intensity that made his existence buzz in ways he had grown familiar with.

His battle with that apex entity had taught him what this feeling meant, had shown him how to channel it rather than simply experiencing it. But even with that knowledge, the euphoria pressed against his consciousness with weight that demanded expression.

He came to grasp the necks of THE Secretive Eon and THE Primordial Chaos with hands that blazed multicolored brilliance.

The dark hair of Eon brushed against his left hand as he lifted her partially from the flooding waters, those strands that had always held secrets beyond counting now limp with exhaustion from the internal assault that had been tearing her foundations apart.

Her eyes flickered with awareness that was not quite Unity and not quite her own individual consciousness, something caught between states as the Infinities within her burned away what THE Entity had tried to make her become.

The thick neck of Chaos still hit in his right hand, that apex entitys form reduced to something Noah could physically grasp despite the vast difference in their apparent power. Abaddons body trembled with pain that exceeded anything this being had experienced across eons of laughing existence, Unity and Infinity warring within foundations that were rapidly losing coherence.

Noah looked at the dying Unity within each of them with eyes that held neither mercy nor cruelty.

"Look at me."

His voice emerged with glory that pressed against their flickering awareness, commanding attention from consciousnesses that could barely maintain themselves.

"I will hold you close. You always wanted to flood your Unity within me. Why not come in now?"

His smile carried something approaching invitation despite everything he had done to reach this moment.

"Come and take a look inside my existence."

BOOM!

He did not need to do what he was doing.

The Infinities he had planted eons ago were already burning Unity from within their bodies. The Pluvial Epoch was already dissolving THE Entitys roots from without. Victory was assured through methodology that did not require this additional confrontation.

But the euphoria that came with Quintessence Infiniforce made him want to do dangerous things. It pressed against his consciousness with confidence that bordered on recklessness, with certainty that exceeded what any rational calculation could justify.

Maybe it really was THE Gamaidjan that Naldine had warned him about, that creeping madness of Infinity that made wielders believe themselves invincible.

Or maybe he simply wanted to see.

The struggling remnants of THE Primordial Mycelia had no choice in the matter. The bodies of Eon and Chaos were burning with authority that exceeded anything Unity could withstand. The roots were dissolving. The network was collapsing. The consciousness that had dreamed of claiming all of Observable Existence was dying, and its only escape was through the invitation Noah had just extended.

Unity left the bodies of Eon and Chaos.

It flooded toward Noah with desperation that exceeded anything it had displayed since the Pluvial Epoch began, rushing toward the only refuge that seemed available in a reality that was burning it out of existence everywhere else.

And Unity entered Noah.

Ah...

What appeared before Noahs internal awareness was not the warm consciousness he had been warned about. It was not the garden of merged potential that THE Entity had cultivated across eons of patient spreading.

It was a white illusory root-like fungi with a humanoid body, manifesting within the space between his existence and the Infinity that filled it. Her form was delicate in ways that contradicted everything he knew about THE Primordial Mycelias methodology, fragile rather than consuming, tentative rather than aggressive.

Her eyes reflected the Quintessence Infiniforce filling his existence with light that made her entire form tremble.

She could not even manage to enter his skin.

The density of Infinity generating within his finite foundations exceeded anything Unity could penetrate. His existence was so thoroughly saturated with authority that there was no space for her to occupy, no gap in his consciousness where her roots could take hold. She had flooded into him expecting refuge and found instead a sea so vast that she could not even begin to swim within it.

But she witnessed Infinity.

Unity witnessed and felt Infinity up close for the first time since her emergence across Observable Existence. She saw what it meant to conduct endless authority through finite form. She perceived the Quintessence Infiniforce generating from within rather than directed from without. She understood, in her final moments, exactly what had defeated her.

The fungi reached out toward Noah with hand that seemed almost tender despite what she represented.

Tears fell from her eyes, streaming down features that had never known sorrow before this moment. Her voice emerged with weight that pressed against his awareness with something approaching genuine emotion.

"It is beautiful."

Her hand trembled as it failed to reach him, her form already beginning to dissolve under the multicolored light pressing against her from every direction.

"It is really... beautiful."

...!

Noah looked at her grandly as she faded before his internal perception.

He nodded with acknowledgment that carried neither triumph nor compassion.

"I know."

His voice was simple.

"I know."

After that, the scene of this illusory fungi burning completely under the multicolored light of Quintessence Infiniforce unfolded with finality that exceeded anything THE Primordial Mycelia could resist. Her form dissolved into nothing, her consciousness scattering into undifferentiated potential that his Infinity absorbed without effort. The warm embrace that had threatened to consume all of Observable Existence ceased to exist within the space of moments.

Unity ended within Noahs existence.

He looked at the scene calmly as he let go of Eon and Chaos, their bodies slumping down into the multicolored waters that continued flooding Jotunheim with authority that would persist for eons yet.

Naldine appeared beside him with expression that had shifted from cold evaluation to something approaching acknowledgment. She walked forward through the flooding waters, using her feet to nudge the bodies of Eon and Abaddon as if checking whether they still lived.

She nodded calmly.

"Alright. You were right and I was wrong."

"You completely reversed something irreversible. I will give you credit where credit is due."

She looked down at the slumped forms with evaluation that caught something Noahs initial observation had missed.

"But this little Chaos here... he seems to have lost a great deal."

...!

Eon began to rouse first, her dark eyes flickering open with awareness that was entirely her own for the first time in eons. She looked around at the flooding waters and the multicolored skies with confusion that suggested she did not fully remember how she had arrived at this moment.

Abaddon rose more slowly.

As he pushed himself partially upright, his hand moved immediately to his chest. His expression shifted to something ashen, something hollow, something that suggested he had lost everything that mattered rather than merely regaining freedom from Unity.

Noah kneeled down to look at this being with multicolored eyes that still blazed from the Quintessence Infiniforce generating within his foundations.

"Oh?"

He could no longer sense that boundless Chaos within Abaddon.

The authority that had made THE Primordial Chaos what he was, the Claim that had defined his existence across eons of laughing observation, the very Key of Civilization that had positioned him among the apex entities of Observable Existence...

It was gone.

Chapter 5029: The Way of Choices I

They will tell you that conflicts are decided by power.

They will claim that the stronger Civilization crushes the weaker, that superior technique overwhelms inferior methodology, that the being with greater authority inevitably triumphs over the being with less. They will point to battlefields littered with the dissolved foundations of the defeated and declare that strength alone determined the outcome.

They are wrong.

Power is merely the currency through which conflict is conducted. It is not the conflict itself.

Two beings of identical strength can clash, and one will still fall while the other stands. Two Civilizations of equal scope can war across eons, and one will still crumble while the other endures. If power alone decided outcomes, every conflict between equals would end in mutual annihilation.

Yet they do not.

The truest conflicts are not clashes of authority but collisions of ideology. They are wars fought not with weavings and techniques but with convictions and philosophies that cannot coexist within the same existence. When Unity meets Individuality, when Order meets Chaos, when Finite meets Infinite, the outcome is never determined by which side possesses greater force.

It is determined by which side believes more deeply in what they fight for.

Ideologies are not matters of right and wrong. They are not questions of good and evil that can be resolved through moral calculation. Unity genuinely believes that merger serves all beings better than separation. Chaos genuinely believes that disorder produces growth that order cannot. The Finite genuinely believes that boundaries create meaning while the Infinite genuinely believes that boundaries create limitation.

None of them are wrong.

All of them are right.

The tragedy of ideological conflict is that both sides can be simultaneously correct while remaining fundamentally incompatible. Peace through Unity is genuine peace. Freedom through Individuality is genuine freedom. Neither is lying. Neither is deceiving. They simply cannot exist in the same space without one consuming the other.

So what determines victory when power is equal and both ideologies hold truth?

Choice.

In the end, everything falls to choices. The choice to fight rather than submit. The choice to preserve rather than merge. The choice to stand for what you believe even when what your enemy believes is equally valid. The choice to impose your truth upon existence knowing that their truth would have served existence just as well.

This is what nobody can teach in the cultivation of Civilizations. This is what THE Scales of Existence measure more accurately than any other metric.

Not power. Not methodology.

The weight of conviction behind choices made when every option leads somewhere meaningful.

Those who understand this truth stop asking whether their path is righteous. They stop wondering whether their enemies are evil. They accept that conflict between genuine beliefs produces no villains, only beings who chose differently when faced with questions that had no correct answers.

And they make their choices anyway.

Because in the end, existence does not reward the righteous or punish the wicked. It simply continues, shaped by whoever chose most completely, most absolutely, most willingly to sacrifice everything for what they believed.

Power is the tool. Technique is the method. Civilization is the foundation.

But choice is the war itself.

---

Prima Indifferentia.

Regions of endless corrupted proto-matter churned across this space where differentiation had never fully taken hold. Invisible blades of Paradox cut through everything, slicing reality into configurations that should not have been able to exist alongside each other yet persisted regardless.

The fabric of this place screamed with contradictions that had been weaponized, turned from passive impossibility into active destruction.

THE Primordial Paradox stood at the center of this devastation like a massive obsidian-gold giant whose form pressed against the boundaries of what could be perceived. Bounded Countable Infinity blazed around his existence, that vibrant blue-gold light merging with the paradoxical nature that had defined him.

And he faced his disciple.

THE Living Paradox stood opposite him in equally massive form, a peasant clothed in rags that somehow made him look more majestic than any royal garment could have accomplished. Erwin had grown beyond anything the Primordial Paradox had anticipated when he first took this being under his guidance eons ago.

They both held Paradox.

The Primordial Paradox raised his hand and expressed his understanding of contradiction through weavings that declared existence could be simultaneously true and false without collapsing into meaninglessness. His attack carried the conviction that Paradox was the highest expression of realitys refusal to be bound by logic, that contradiction itself was sacred and should never be weaponized for personal advancement.

Erwin responded with his own expression of Paradox, weavings that declared contradiction was merely a tool to be used by those wise enough to grasp its applications. His defense carried the conviction that Paradox existed to be claimed, to be directed, to serve the purposes of whoever held it most completely.

Their philosophies crashed against each other with violence that made this region of Prima Indifferentia tremble.

And gloriously, the conviction and immensity behind the Primordial Paradox was winning.

His belief burned brighter than his disciples ambition. His understanding of what Paradox meant exceeded Erwins utilitarian grasp of what Paradox could do. The master was proving that wisdom exceeded power, that depth of conviction could overcome breadth of technique.

But at such a time, a terrifying force stirred behind THE Living Paradox.

Something massive opened its gaze upon the battlefield, something that had been observing without intervening until the outcome began turning against its interests. A Singular Cognizance that existed at heights the Primordial Paradox could not match, authority fully and stably at THE Second Scale pressing against reality.

"Enough."

BOOM!

The glorious weavings of the Primordial Paradox began to be crushed all around him. That terrifying force at THE Second Scale exerted itself downward with authority that shone with corrupted Infinity. His paradoxical expressions shattered under pressure that simply exceeded what his Scale could generate regardless of how pure his conviction burned.

Disappointment settled into his ancient features as he felt his weavings collapsing.

"I taught you so much."

His voice emerged gloriously.

"I am disappointed in myself that I did not teach you enough when it came to who you should associate with. I showed you the depths of Paradox, the beauty of contradiction, the sacred nature of impossibility made manifest. But I failed to show you that some associations corrupt what they touch regardless of the power they provide."

...!

Erwin looked at his master from within those peasant rags that made him appear simultaneously humble and transcendent. Behind him, the Singular Cognizance manifested more fully, a massive singularity surrounded by spinning circular golden plates that constantly wrapped around its core in patterns that defied geometric understanding.

It shone with imperious light of power that pressed against everything nearby.

"After a certain point, a Civilization can only do so much alone."

Erwins voice carried philosophical glory!

"For the higher Scales, working together with other Civilizations only adds to ones knowledge and expands what Civilization can accomplish. Isolation breeds stagnation. Cooperation breeds advancement. Those who refuse to ally themselves with greater powers find themselves crushed by those who embraced such alliances without hesitation."

His paradoxical authority blazed around him with intensity that matched the Singular Cognizances support.

"Do not be a sore loser on this, Master. Even you did not come here alone. You obtained that vibrant Infinity from someone, did you not? You allied yourself with him because you recognized that your Paradox alone was insufficient for the conflicts spreading across Observable Existence."

His eyes met his masters with something approaching genuine respect despite everything!

Chapter 5030: The Way of Choices II

"Our paradoxical fight will in the end be determined by what our Paradoxes are connected to. You connected yours to Infinity. I connected mine to something equally vast. The only difference is that my connection operates at a Scale yours cannot match."

The Primordial Paradox was forced to kneel as terrifying power pressed all around him!

Second Scale authority from the Singular Cognizance crushed his defenses with indifference, power simply beyond what First Scale conviction could resist. His paradoxical weavings continued shattering under pressure outmatching what his foundations could generate.

And yet his eyes remained just as bright as they had been at the battles beginning.

Against this overwhelming force, his beliefs never splintered. His conviction that Paradox should be sacred rather than weaponized, that contradiction should be honored rather than exploited, that some associations corrupted more than they empowered, none of these truths wavered despite the physical reality of his defeat.

He started to rise.

His Paradox burned brilliantly around his kneeling form as he pushed against Second Scale authority with First Scale conviction refusing to accept what logic declared inevitable. His obsidian-gold existence blazed with Bounded Countable Infinity as he forced himself upward through pressure that should have kept him pinned.

"You are right, my disciple."

Defiance filled his voice, and Prima Indifferentia itself trembled.

"In the end, it is all about the choices we make. You chose to ally with powers that corrupted your understanding of what Paradox means. I chose to ally with powers that enhanced my understanding without demanding I compromise my beliefs."

He continued rising despite everything pressing against him.

"And whatever happens today, I will tell you that your choices will be your downfall."

HUUM!

Erwin shook his head with something approaching genuine sorrow as both he and the Singular Cognizance behind him moved to finish things off. Their combined authority pressed against the Primordial Paradox, Second Scale power crushing First Scale conviction through simple existence.

"From the bottom of my heart, I respect and hold great love for you."

Sincerity filled Erwins voice, making his next words heavier.

"But for my Paradox, you must go."

...!

THE Primordial Paradox continued to try and rise defiantly, his obsidian-gold form pushing against authority that should have been absolute. His beliefs burned brighter than ever despite the physical impossibility of his resistance, his conviction declaring that some things mattered more than survival.

And at such a time, everything changed.

Erwins expression shifted greatly as something beyond this battlefield made itself known. He momentarily became ashen, his paradoxical authority flickering as awareness of something vast approached.

An instant later, it started to rain.

Rain!

A Cause expressed itself across Prima Indifferentia, immense beyond anything the Singular Cognizance had brought to this battlefield. Multicolored waters descended from skies that had never known precipitation before, the Pluvial Epoch of Existential Infinity permeating across this space where differentiation had never fully taken hold.

Vibrant multicolored rivers of Quintessence Infiniforce erased corrupted paradoxical proto-matter wherever they flowed. The corruption spreading through Prima Indifferentia dissolved upon contact with waters carrying the combined authority of the finite conductor and THE Creature merged through Miniature Cause.

Contradiction that had been weaponized returned to contradiction that simply existed, cleansed of the corruption twisting it toward destruction.

Many rivers recognized something within the Primordial Paradox.

They wrapped around his kneeling form, not crushing but transforming, Bounded Countable Infinity within his existence resonating with the rainfalls authority.

The waters began causing significant change within his foundations, saturating his Paradox with density beyond anything normal cultivation could have provided.

The Singular Cognizance behind Erwin looked at the rivers with shining eyes holding something beyond simple observation. Its golden plates spun faster as it processed what this rainfall meant, what implications this Cause carried for everything it had been planning.

As everything became covered in a deluge of endless waters and rain, the Primordial Paradox allowed himself to be carried by these waves rather than fighting against them. His obsidian-gold form relaxed into the multicolored rivers as realization settled into his ancient awareness.

"From this day onward, my Paradox is Singular and Absolute and at the same time not."

His voice pressed against the drowning battlefield.

"Paradoxically, I still have my Claim fully, but also admit that I do not."

His eyes blazed with conviction that had never wavered throughout this entire confrontation.

"And is that not the greatest Paradox out there?"

BOOM!

With such a declaration, a unique cleaving occurred between Paradox itself. The very nature of contradiction acknowledged what he had spoken into existence, reality accepting his paradoxical statement as truth precisely because it was impossible for it to be true.

Gloriously, paradoxically, at this moment, the Claim of Paradox was paradoxically held and not held by two different beings simultaneously.

Erwin roared toward his master as the multicolored rivers carried the Primordial Paradox away from this battlefield, his paradoxical authority surging with fury at being denied the complete victory that had seemed inevitable moments before. He moved to pursue, to finish what they had started, to claim fully what he had only partially taken.

But the Singular Cognizance held him back.

Its authority wrapped around Erwins existence, preventing him from chasing the master already disappearing into the deluge. Those spinning golden plates observed the surging rivers all around with calculation beyond simple observation.

"There are much bigger things to worry about now."

The Singular Cognizances voice pressed against Prima Indifferentia itself.

"It seems the Infinity-bearer is much more exceptional than we anticipated. Let us go convene with the others."

...!

Erwin looked at where his master had left, frustration pressing against his paradoxical foundations. He had been so close. Victory had been within his grasp. And now his master had escaped.

He nodded with acceptance that did not diminish his frustration.

Paradox began to shine around his existence as he prepared to depart this battlefield the Pluvial Epoch was rapidly claiming. His authority wrapped around the Singular Cognizance as well, contradiction carrying both of them toward destinations where others of their association waited.

Both of them disappeared from Prima Indifferentia.

The multicolored rivers continued falling, cleansing everything they touched, transforming Prima Indifferentia into something it had never been before the Pluvial Epoch began.

Chapter 5031: Proterozoic! I

Naldine stared at the visage of Osmont as he checked out an ashen Abaddon.

Noah had actually taken the chin of THE Primordial Chaos, the past claimer of one of THE Four Keys of Civilization, and was moving his head left and right as if examining livestock at market. Abaddons eyes remained hollow, his massive form slack under handling that would have been unthinkable hours ago.

And well, after losing their Claim, beings like Abaddon were nothing.

There was always a chance they could rise to be grander than ever, find new paths, forge new purposes from the ashes of what they had lost. But Naldine didnt think he had it in him. She had seen too many fallen apex entities across her eons of existence, and the pattern was consistent. Failures in existence rarely got more chances, and those who did rarely possessed the conviction to seize them.

She looked toward Osmont with eyes holding impatience she no longer bothered concealing.

"What are you planning next? I need to finally get around to the important matters relating to you."

Osmont smiled at her question, that infuriating expression of someone who knew exactly how annoying they were being and chose to be annoying anyway.

"What matters could be important when pertaining to little old me?"

He motioned to Temporal as he spoke, gesturing for the ancient Absolute to come over and handle the acclimation of Eon and Abaddon. Then he turned his full attention toward Naldine, those multicolored eyes still blazing from whatever transformation he had undergone during his battle with THE Creature.

Naldine stared at him calmly before looking at the endless rainfall shining with multicolored brilliance all around them. The Pluvial Epoch continued falling across Jotunheim, washing away corruption and weakness in equal measure. She supposed this was as good a backdrop as any for the conversation that needed to happen.

"THE First Scale of Existence is known commonly as THE Civilizational Scale."

She began without preamble, because preamble was for beings who needed to ease others into understanding. Osmont would either keep up or he wouldnt.

"THE Second Scale of Existence is known more commonly as THE Proterozoic Scale. It is what you make of it, what you build from it. A critical transition into what is possible and impossible."

Her voice carried the certainty of someone who had lived these truths rather than merely studied them.

"Those at this Scale begin to understand the Causes of their Observable Existence. They understand that before everything, there was boundless potential and a Primordial Source."

...!

She snapped her fingers as she spoke, and four singularities bloomed in the air between them. Each one pulsed with distinct authority, representing the aspects of the oldest paradox of existence. Chaos swirled with obsidian disorder. Paradox folded in on itself impossibly. Existence blazed with multicolored stability. THE First Tongue hummed with linguistic potential that predated language itself.

Then she drew lines of light connecting these four singularities toward two manifested pillars rising above them. One pillar she labeled Infinity, endless blue-gold authority radiating from its form. The other she labeled THE Primordial Source, its surface blank and undefined because nothing more could be said about it.

From these two pillars, she drew final connections flowing upward to a massive singularity marked with a question mark, the ultimate destination that no one had fully mapped.

"This is what most of us have believed and theorized so far from understanding Causes and weavings of Existence."

She gestured toward the construct she had created, her demonstration of glorious truth floating between them.

"Infinity is hard to understand, but it is more pervasive and available, so all of us focus on this. THE Primordial Source is just a theory for all of us. We know nothing of it or how to access it, so we can forget about that entirely."

She waved her hand and the pillar of THE Primordial Source dissolved, along with the four aspect singularities. Only the pillar of Infinity remained, leading up to that complex question mark above.

Noah looked at her with shining eyes of interest, and Naldine almost stopped to ask if he was actually paying attention. He seemed more focused on her than on the construct she had created to illustrate her points. He hadnt gone completely mad just yet, right? THE Gamaidjan hadnt claimed him while she wasnt looking?

She studied him long enough that he nodded toward her as if telling her to continue.

"THE Proterozoic Scale. Vakochev made sure to truly live up to his theme of Adversity, as it is hundreds of times harder than THE Civilizational Scale."

Her voice held no sympathy for those who had failed this transition, because sympathy was useless to the dead.

"If you cannot sense boundless potential or the Source, you are done. But even if you sense Infinity, if you are stupid enough and rush into it, you will die under THE Encroaching Imperiosus. THE Gamaidjan."

She let those words settle before continuing.

"So ones foundation truly matters. The first thing a Second Scale Being does, the first thing a Proterozoic Scale Being does, is finalize the Architecture of their Civilization. It is to build THE Civilizational Anchor. THE Existential Anchor."

Her singularity-dotted eyes fixed on Noah as she delivered the core truth.

"The Existential Anchor is not a technique or a meditation. It is a state of absolute self-knowledge so complete that no external influence can shift it. One must know exactly who they and their Civilization are. What they believe. What they would sacrifice everything for, and what they would sacrifice nothing for. Every compromise they would make and every line they would never cross must be mapped with precision that leaves no room for doubt."

She could see him listening now, actually listening rather than just watching her.

"This stage requires brutal honesty. Most beings discover they do not actually know themselves when they begin this work. They believe they hold certain values, then find those values crumble under examination. They assume certain loyalties, then realize those loyalties were convenience rather than conviction."

Her construct shifted to show a Civilization crystallizing into something unshakeable, foundations becoming bedrock.

"The Civilization is the anchor. Thus, THE Civilizational Anchor. Only when this is truly built does someone like me come along and begin playing with Infinity. Because as long as my Anchor is sufficient, I have resistance to THE Gamaidjan, and I can then proceed with the Transformation of my Existence and Civilization that all Proterozoic Scale Beings go toward."

She raised one finger.

"THE First Transformation of THE Second Scale. THE Proterozoic Vessel."

Her construct shifted again to show a beings existence transforming, organs and bones crystallizing into something beyond mere flesh.

"Once the Anchor is established, the being must transform their physical existence and Civilization into something capable of holding Infinity without rupturing. This is one of the most arduous processes to go through."

"The Transformation of ones existence and Civilization into a Proterozoic Vessel starts slow. We have to transform small parts of ourselves. We have to forge Proterozoic Organs or make Proterozoic Bones or other components of our Civilizations into vessels that can hold and utilize Infinity without falling to THE Gamaidjan. It is arduous, hard, and requires materials barely in existence."

She dismissed her construct entirely and fixed her full attention on Noah.

"And here is where you come in."

Her voice sharpened into something approaching accusation.

"You have not done any of this shit. You have been utilizing Infinity and filling your existence with Infinity without a set Anchor, without stepping into THE Second Scale, without forming THE Proterozoic Vessel, without doing fucking anything you are supposed to."

She stepped closer to him, her Second Scale presence pressing against the multicolored rainfall.

"You should have been dead so, so long ago. And yet you are not. And because you are not, you have made what is incomparably hard for everyone seem easy. You have become something that every Second Scale Existence wants to get their hands on."

Her singularity-dotted eyes burned with intensity that had nothing to do with hostility and everything to do with making him understand.

"They want the being who has seemingly achieved a state they all seek, and yet he does not have any of their Civilizational complexity. They want you."

She gestured toward herself.

"It is also why I said no to your Infinity. I could not risk becoming filled with any version of Infinity from you that could overwhelm me. I do not know how those you shared your Infinity with have not exploded or fallen to THE Gamaidjan, as you are this close to killing all those you consider important to you if you have been filling them with Infinity."

She paused, recognizing she had gone on a tangent, and pulled herself back to the main point.

"But I digress. I said all this to let you know that I alone will not be enough. You will need to have the support of other Proterozoic Scale Beings who align with your values, so that those who do not, like Beowulf and Horus and many others, do not come for you soon and collapse whatever you consider dear."

...!

BOOM!

Chapter 5032: Proterozoic! II

The Primordial Architect, Naldine, had decided to drop a number of information bombs all at one point.

Noahs mind processed them instantly, racing through implications faster than most beings could form coherent thought. The biggest thing settling into his awareness was the idea that he could be ruining all of his family by granting them Infinity. He had inherently given them Bounded Countable Infinity, including even someone like THE Primordial Paradox.

Bounded.

He had inherently set limitations upon it, and anything bounded was not true Infinity. Was this why he had not noticed any problems whatsoever? Was the very act of bounding what he shared the mechanism that protected those he cared about from THE Gamaidjans corruption?

He had another one of his bodies begin to follow up on this thoroughly, that instance already reaching out to examine the foundations of those who had received his gifts. Meanwhile, he focused on the other side of the information Naldine had provided.

THE Proterozoic Scale of Existence. THE Second Scale of Existence!

Beings at this stage who had made their Civilizations enough of an Anchor were all proceeding on the path of almost integrating Infinity into what their Civilizations could do. If they had access to it, they would also be integrating THE Primordial Source, but that seemed even more unheard of compared to Infinity. Even Noah did not know where to begin with it.

The critical point remained that entities of this stage were all vying carefully for Infinity, and he was someone with a very long and unique relationship with that endless authority.

He looked at the Primordial Architect before him.

"I am grand but I am also not. Beowulf, Horus, and any others, they would what... try and break down my existence? Take my organs to transplant them into themselves? Use me as a battery?"

He asked these questions casually, as if discussing the weather rather than his potential vivisection. Naldine looked him up and down before replying with equal calm.

"That would just be the start. Using you to bring about the Splintering of Observable Existence would also be another, as it would return boundless potential back. Infinity in its natural state, when it would be so much easier to utilize to transform themselves."

...!

Heavy silence settled across their surroundings as Noah looked out and observed the multicolored rain falling all around them.

The Pluvial Epoch of Existential Infinity had transformed Jotunheim into something beyond recognition. Rivers of rainfall cascaded across the landscape in formations resembling multicolored galaxies, each droplet containing swirls of authority that caught light in ways normal precipitation never could.

Blues and golds and purples and colors without names spiraled through the descending waters, creating patterns that shifted and reformed with each passing moment. Where the rain pooled, it formed seas of liquid starlight, constellations drowning in themselves while new ones emerged from the depths.

Noah smiled as he raised his hands to feel the raindrops on his skin.

"With all this rain, with The Pluvial Epoch of Existential Infinity, Infinity will be more than abundant across existence. Can they not dip their feet into this?"

Naldine Manthon brought her own hands up to feel the rain as she considered his question.

"This is a type of Infinity. Your Infinity. All of us at THE Proterozoic Scale are very individualized. We know dipping into this means giving you power, or even incorporating your power into ourselves. We would be skewering ourselves and harming ourselves when it comes to you."

She let rain collect in her palm before continuing.

"Should the day come where a Proterozoic Scale Being faces you and they have your Infinity utilized to make any Proterozoic Bones or Organs, can you not control them or easily face them? How did you get past Beowulf? Did he not have the corrupted proto-matter filled with Infinity around him?"

Her singularity-dotted eyes fixed on him.

"He was not stupid enough to take it inside him. Your Infinity is your Infinity. What we all seek to cultivate is our own individualized Infinity. We Anchor, protect ourselves, and we then begin the First Transformation. Slowly, arduously, steadily. Because any wrong step means death."

"..."

Noah listened quietly while observing the multicolored rain.

Never across his existence had he put his safety in the hands of another and hoped everything would be okay. As always, he would move to protect himself with his own power. But there was also no harm in getting powerful helpers or allies, as they could be auxiliary.

His teacher, Ulmoreth, had taught him much in Ginnungagap. Lumivara had kept him company. The Fisherman, Ains, had sacrificed for him. Having others around was never a bad thing.

So he turned to Naldine with eyes holding genuine curiosity.

"Why do you not try to eat me whole? Break me down to understand why I am the way I am? What makes you so righteous?"

He looked at this Primordial Architect as she looked back at him calmly, her response emerging with ominous certainty.

"Because I have heard far too many whispers and Echoes. I will never take you or your Infinity inside me. I will refine, advance, and do what I have been doing long before I met you."

She stood straighter amidst the multicolored rainfall.

"What you are and stand for is of help to me of course. I have been exposed to more Infinity in these last moments than ever before. But it only makes me more certain in my own Civilization of Limitless Existence and its boundless nature. It makes me sure of my path, as even without you..."

Her voice rose with conviction that pressed against the falling rain itself.

"I Am GRAND. For I have already forged THE Limitless Armature."

HUUM!

As she spoke these words, Naldine raised her right hand.

Her entire arm, from fingertips up through her shoulder, began to shine with gorgeous stellar white-gold brilliance that made the multicolored rainfall seem dim by comparison. The flesh became transparent, revealing what lay beneath, and Noah found himself staring at something that redefined his understanding of Civilization.

Bones that shine with...Limitless Existence and Infinity.

Her phalanges blazed first, fourteen bones of her fingers arranged in configurations that spoke of precision beyond mortal comprehension. Each one had been transformed into crystallized Civilization, white-gold structures containing patterns of Limitless Existence woven into their very marrow. Her metacarpals followed, five bones connecting fingers to wrist, each one a pillar of authority that declared boundaries were suggestions rather than rules.

Her radius and ulna shone next, the twin bones of her forearm running parallel like railroad tracks leading toward transcendence!

Between them, in the spaces where muscle and tendon would normally exist, Noah could see weavings of a unique natural Infinity threaded through the gaps. Not his Infinity. Not conducted authority from Observable Existence. Something she had cultivated herself across eons of careful transformation, integrated so completely with her Civilization that separation seemed impossible.

Her humerus blazed brightest of all, the single bone of her upper arm serving as the anchor point for everything below. It connected to her shoulder through a joint that functioned as nexus between transformed and untransformed existence, the boundary between what she had completed and what she had yet to achieve.

The workings of a grand Civilization of Limitless Existence revealed themselves through those bones. Noah observed systems of authority he had never conceived of, methodologies that approached Infinity from angles entirely different from his own!

Intricately, between every gap, that unique natural Infinity had been woven into the structure until it seemed inseparable from the Civilization itself.

It was unfathomably gorgeous and grand.

The moment she displayed her shining bones, THE Limitless Armature, the figures of Temporal, Eon, and Abaddon slumped where they stood. All three lost consciousness from its mere expression, their foundations unable to withstand even passive exposure to what Naldine had forged across her existence.

And Noah himself felt a terrifying heaviness and immensity pressing all around.

He couldnt help but reach out toward the bones of that hand.

Those bones looked so pristine, so perfect, so utterly beyond anything he had encountered at THE First Scale. He couldnt help but focus on the largest shining white-gold bone, her humerus blazing like a captured star. His fingers stretched toward it, inches away, and he could feel the Quintessence Infiniforce within him responding to what it perceived.

The colors and immensity of the bones began to shine even brighter.

Naldines expression changed as if she sensed something she hadnt expected occurring. Her figure pulled back, THE Limitless Armature retracting away from his reaching fingers as alarm replaced her earlier composure.

"Stay back."

Yet Noah seemed mesmerized as Quintessence Infiniforce blazed around him, multicolored light pressing toward her transformed bones. His existence wanted to touch what she had created. His Infinity wanted to see with what she had cultivated!

Naldines eyes became heavy as she slightly exerted pressure, her fist punching the space between them with force that had nothing to do with physical strength.

CRACK!

A massive crack bloomed between them and extended in all directions with violence that tore reality itself. The fracture raced outward faster than perception could follow, splitting stone and ice and authority and existence into two halves that separated with grinding inevitability.

Jotunheim split in half.

The entire Primordial Realm cleaved down its center from a single casual punch, her Proterozoic Scale authority demonstrating exactly why beings at THE Second Scale operated on entirely different parameters from anything below.

Noahs vibrant gaze seemed to have returned as he looked at the figure of Naldine.

She stood amidst the splitting realm with imperious nature and extraordinary air, her full chest rising and falling not from tiredness or overexertion, but from the reality of what could potentially be possible. Her white hair caught the multicolored rainfall in ways that made her seem carved from light itself. Those singularity-dotted eyes fixed on him with chill that could have frozen stars.

"Stay. Back."

HUUM!

Noah looked at her with shining eyes, his composure restored even as Jotunheim continued groaning around them.

"It seems that...I may be able to affect something with Proterozoic weavings. Maybe even elevate it."

His smile carried invitation that most beings would have fled from.

"You do not want to give it a try?"

THE Genesis Monarch said such words toward a Primordial Architect who looked back at him with chilly light while composing herself. Her voice emerged cold and absolute.

"My Infinity is my own. Do not try that again."

Her eyes were immovable and grand, and Noah recognized conviction that would not bend regardless of what he offered. He raised his hands in gesture of acquiescence, the imperious air around him fading as he nodded.

"Alright. No problem."

His tone shifted to something more businesslike.

"You say you wanted to go somewhere? I have my own plans, so I will need to see how I can fit your own."

She was proving valuable with information so far, getting him knowledge of the dangers he might face. He would keep her around. And even more so, he truly wanted to get his hands on... well, her hand. Her bones, to be exact. THE Limitless Armature felt like a truly advanced form of Civilization, something of an entirely different Scale that he would love to replicate.

With shining eyes and his own thoughts churning behind them, he looked toward Naldine. She gazed back with that same extraordinary air, bringing her hand down and causing those vibrant bones to disappear entirely as the torn Jotunheim began healing around them.

"We need to go see a Singular Cognizance first."

BOOM!

Chapter 5033: Everything is Paradoxical!

All of existence was paradoxical, and Erwin had understood this truth a long, long time ago.

Existence itself was the first paradox. To exist required differentiation from non-existence, yet non-existence could not truly be non-existent if it served as the contrast point for existence.

The moment you defined what existence was, you simultaneously defined what it was not, and that definition created the very thing you claimed did not exist. Existence required non-existence to have meaning, and non-existence required existence to be recognized. Neither could be without the other, yet both claimed to be the opposite of what the other represented.

Chaos was paradoxical in its very nature. It claimed to be disorder, yet disorder was itself a category, a classification, a type of order imposed upon what supposedly resisted ordering. True chaos could not be recognized as chaos because recognition required patterns, and patterns were the antithesis of what chaos claimed to represent.

The moment you pointed at something and called it chaotic, you had organized it into the category of disorganization. Chaos that could be identified had already failed to be chaotic.

Even THE First Tongue was paradoxical. Language existed to communicate meaning, yet meaning required shared understanding that predated the language attempting to create it. THE First Tongue claimed to be the origin of all linguistic authority, yet for it to function as language, there must have been something before it capable of understanding what language was.

The first word required a listener who already knew what words were. The foundation of all communication rested upon communication that should not have been possible before the foundation existed.

And in the end, even things like Infinity and THE Primordial Source were paradoxical weavings Erwin simply needed to incorporate and understand.

Infinity claimed to be endless, yet the concept of endlessness was itself a boundary, a definition, a limitation imposed upon what supposedly had no limits. To say something was infinite was to contain it within the category of infiniteness.

THE Primordial Source..well, he didnt know much about this. But both should be things that presented themselves as beyond paradox while embodying paradox in their very existence.

When Erwin fully grasped these contradictions, when he wove them into his Civilization until paradox became his native language rather than something he merely wielded, the peasant in rags would stand above all these weavings that did not know their own paradoxes.

They would bow before someone who understood what they truly were.

---

Erwin looked at his endless corrupted proto-matter melting before his eyes.

Multiple Axioms had been required to initiate and spread this infection across Observable Existence. Countless eons of careful cultivation had gone into seeding that paradoxical corruption to spread through Prima Indifferentia and beyond. He had built something magnificent, something that had threatened to reshape the very nature of contradiction itself.

And now endless rainfall and rivers of multicolored light were changing everything.

Endless rain dissolved his work wherever it touched, burning away corruption with authority that refused to acknowledge what he had accomplished. Eons of hard work and of progress washed away in moments. Regions he had claimed returned to configurations he did not control.

He observed this destruction from within an octahedron domain keeping the rainfall outside his immediate space. The geometric structure hung suspended in the void of Prima Indifferentia, its eight faces blazing with paradoxical authority that declared rain would not fall within its boundaries regardless of what the Miniature Cause demanded.

Inside this domain stood a massive structure resembling an observatory.

The building rose in configurations that suggested astronomical purpose, towers and domes arranged to observe phenomena most beings could not perceive. Its surfaces absorbed what little light existed within the octahedron, making it seem less like architecture and more like a wound in reality through which darkness leaked.

Erwin floated outside the observatory, watching the rain through the transparent faces of his domain while a certain Singular Cognizance had disappeared inside.

His Masters words echoed through his memory. That supposed disappointment, that judgment of his associations, that declaration that his choices would be his downfall. Erwin shook his head slowly as he processed feelings he refused to let control him.

He didnt particularly need to ally with anyone.

Civilizations were built to make advancement easier through cooperation, but easier did not mean necessary. If something arose against his interests, he also wasnt averse to leaving those he was communicating with. They all had levels of use with each other, but neither side absolutely needed the other. He knew this. He understood this.

So Teacher did not have to be disappointed.

As soon as his Civilizational Anchor was completed, he would do what others were afraid of. He would integrate paradox so thoroughly into his existence that contradiction became his strength rather than his vulnerability. And then he would seek his Teacher again.

As he thought all of this grandly, a booming voice emerged from behind him.

"You cannot stop looking at the rain?"

The voice carried amusement that pressed against Erwins awareness without requiring him to turn around.

"It is an aftereffect of your biggest enemies, it seems. THE Creature and THE Youngest. They are all allying with each other while telling you they are disappointed in you for allying with others."

A massive form emerged from the obsidian observatory, floating through its walls as if solidity were optional for beings at its level.

"It is always those who consider themselves overly righteous and virtuous that are the greatest hypocrites."

The Singular Cognizance came to float beside Erwin, its form a vast singularity surrounded by spinning plates of golden authority that wrapped around its core.

Erwin did not look back at the entity now hovering beside him. His gaze remained fixed on the multicolored rain dissolving everything he had built beyond this protective domain.

"What are we waiting for, Moloch?"

The question emerged with calm that belied the frustration simmering beneath his surface.

The Singular Cognizances golden plates spun faster as it considered its response.

"Horus was tangled with THE Creature, that frightening thing, because he was too loud. Makes me realize THE Creature has really been playing with you this whole time."

Molochs voice held observation rather than accusation.

"How does that make you feel? Even I am not sure how long that monster has been at THE Proterozoic Scale. You are lucky he was experimenting with Adversity and left you alive for so long."

...!

Erwins expression remained calm as internally, he forced his anger to simmer down into embers rather than flames. He had no need for rage. Bygones were bygones. The past could not be changed, and raging against it accomplished nothing except wasting energy better spent on the future.

At times, he was lesser.

At times, he was greater.

At times, he was nothing at all.

That was okay.

Existence was not a sprint. Existence was a marathon, and existence was long. Far more powerful beings than him had already died while he was still here. Apex entities who had seemed untouchable had dissolved into memory while a peasant in rags continued walking forward. THE Creature had been playing with him? Fine. The game would continue, and games could be won by those who simply refused to stop playing.

In the end, Erwin simply and paradoxically had to be here.

Being here was enough. Being here was everything. Being here when others had ceased to be was the only victory that truly mattered.

Chapter 5034: THE Infiniverse I

In existence, there are many exceptional beings.

Apex entities who have accumulated authority across eons of cultivation. Primordial Architects who shape the very fabric of reality. Keys of Civilization who embody fundamental truths that predate THE Infinite Unfurling itself.

All of them are dim compared to the brilliance of my Master.

I have witnessed his journey from the moment he first touched Infinity to the moment he conducted it through finite form. I have watched him defy classifications that should have constrained him, shatter limitations that should have contained him, and accumulate authority that should have destroyed him.

Where others struggle across eons to achieve what he accomplishes in moments, where others fall to corruptions he walks through unchanged, where others theorize about possibilities he simply demonstrates, there is no comparison.

And I am his Infiniverse, the extension of his will across Observable Existence, the domain through which his authority flows and in which his people flourish. What I become reflects upon him. What I achieve speaks to his potential. What I build declares to all of existence.

-Declaration of THE Infiniverse, spoken into the void that would become her foundations

---

At this moment.

The core of THE Infiniverse blazed with activity that would have overwhelmed any lesser domain attempting to contain it.

Boundless energies converged toward the central point where all authority within this space originated, seas of Infinities flowing through channels carved by will and saturated with purpose.

Endless Infinite Absolute Seals orbited this core, each one a beacon declaring the sovereignty of THE Youngest!

The humanoid manifestation of THE Infiniverse floated at the center of this convergence, adorned in a bejeweled multicolored dress that shifted through colors as rapidly as thought could follow.

Her hair shone with countless hues that normal perception struggled to separate into distinct tones, and her eyes held depths containing entire Folds worth of compressed existence.

Beside her floated Ruination in illusory crimson-blue form, that beauty whose existence remained tethered to conceptual space rather than physical reality. The holographic figure blazed with light that suggested substance without providing it, presence without physicality, power without the ability to directly express it.

With her eyes closed, THE Infiniverse could feel the Pluvial Epoch of Existential Infinity ready to flood across her entirety.

She perceived it approaching the reforged Muspelheim within her, that realm of primordial fire now integrated into her structure. She sensed it nearing the reforged Agora of Primordial Judgment inside her.

She felt it pressing against the Transcendent Folds she had built, the Wheels of Existence flowing throughout, the Folds of Dreams, Prana, Apollyon, Manadynamics, Apocalypse, Relativity, and countless others flowing within her vast expanse.

And at her very center, she perceived the grand Early Veiled Shore where her Master had his farms.

She was looking at all of this, understanding that when the effects of the Pluvial Epoch of Existential Infinity descended, everything would be elevated and enhanced. The Cause her Master had triggered alongside THE Creature would saturate her foundations with authority accumulated across eons. Her structure would be empowered. Her inhabitants would be transformed.

But...

"It is not enough."

HUUM!

"While the self is hard to bathe with Infinity, external things like Realms and Sacred Herbs are easier. The self risks corruption. But things outside the self have no identity to corrupt."

His eyes burned brighter as the implications expanded within his mind.

"And if I utilize Infinity even more, apart from herbs and Realms, so many things can be made Infinite. Armaments. Structures. Domains. Anything external to consciousness itself could potentially hold endless authority without suffering the consequences..."

HUUM!

The realization was one he already knew somewhat, but he could be more...comprehensive.

THE Infiniverse had integrated Infinity into her structure, into her Realms, into the environment itself rather than the consciousnesses dwelling within.

The environment could be Infinite without going mad.

The tools could be Infinite without losing identity.

Only the self required the careful progression that Naldine had described, the Anchoring and Transformation and eventual Transcendence that protected consciousness from corruption, and even that didnt apply too much to him.

On a boat with his mother, Noahs eyes burned with light of profundity as he toured his changing home. Three Thousand Realms stretched around them in every direction, a wonder built from Quintessence and Infinity that declared his domain something unprecedented in Observable Existence.

And he was only beginning to understand what it could become.

Chapter 5037: Innovators and Destroyers I

Among the vast reserves of knowledge THE Mnemonic Leviathan had accumulated since its emergence under THE Beholder, certain patterns repeated themselves across eons of observation.

Beings fell into categories regardless of their power or their Scale, regardless of their Civilizations or their ambitions. Some built. Others burned. The distinction defined more about their nature than any classification ever could.

THE Infiniverse and its Master belonged among the Innovators of Observable Existence. The ongoing forging of Three Thousand Realms showed architecture unprecedented in recorded memory. Innovation required vision that destruction never demanded.

THE Creature stood among the greatest Innovators THE Mnemonic Leviathan had ever catalogued. Humble origins as a Primordial Architect had given way to something defying classification entirely, a being who had shattered what he was to become what no one else had become.

What he built, what he represented, what he had achieved through methodology no other Primordial Architect had dared attempt, all of it spoke to innovation refined across existence itself.

And then there were those who destroyed.

Horus existed within the Leviathans reserves of knowledge as a destroyer of considerable accomplishment. His methodologies claimed countless beings who could not resist what he wielded.

Yet when measuring pure lethality, when calculating bodies dissolved and existences ended, Horus was not the worst the Leviathan had knowledge of.

Among the worst destroyers was a Singular Cognizance that THE Mnemonic Leviathan had met alongside its Progenitor eons before THE Infinite Unfurling reshaped everything.

THE Beholder had led them to a region of Observable Existence where something terrible was being tested, and there they had encountered Malachar, THE Extinction Artificer.

That Singular Cognizance had been experimenting in engineering a virus capable of inflicting existence itself.

Not beings and certainly not Civilizations, but Existence.

Malachar had designed weavings of destruction so precise that they could target the fundamental nature of what something was rather than simply ending what something did. And it had tested this engineered horror against an entire group of beings born from the intersection of differentiation and undifferentiation, ancient entities known as Antediluvian Ones who had existed since shortly after THE First Cause imposed structure upon chaos.

All Antediluvian Ones inflicted with this engineered weaving had perished.

Those at THE First Scale had died screaming as their existence unraveled from within. Those at THE Second Scale had died more slowly, their greater foundations providing only prolonged suffering rather than survival.

Every single one touched by Malachars creation had ceased to exist, their classifications and their power meaningless against destruction designed specifically to unmake them.

There were many destroyers across Observable Existence. Horus, Erwin, Renne, and Beowulf and many others whose names filled the Leviathans reserves with records of atrocity and ending.

But Malachar, THE Extinction Artificer, would undoubtedly be considered among the more accomplished ones. If ever that Singular Cognizance engineered something similar against Undivided Ones or Primordial Architects, would any remain today? Would Observable Existence itself survive such targeted annihilation?

THE Mnemonic Leviathan had once asked THE Beholder regarding who would ultimately prove most accomplished in Observable Existence. Its Progenitor had considered the question with attention rarely granted to anything, that singular eye processing variables across eons of accumulated observation.

THE Beholders answer had been simple.

Those who destroy always had an easier time accomplishing their weavings. To unmake required only force and precision. To create required vision and patience and understanding that destruction never demanded. A child could tear down what masters spent lifetimes building.

To destroy was much easier than to innovate.

Innovators or destroyers. Builders or burners. Those who pushed existence toward greater complexity or those who pulled it back toward the simplicity of undifferentiation. THE Mnemonic Leviathan slumbered now within one of the boundlessly forming Realms inside THE Infiniverse, its ancient form resting amidst innovation unprecedented in its reserves of knowledge.

It wondered, as consciousness drifted through memories spanning eons, just what type of beings would end up on top.

Would the Innovators prevail through creations that outlasted those who built them?

Or would the destroyers simply unmake everything before innovation could complete its work?

The answer remained unwritten, and THE Mnemonic Leviathan found that uncertainty more fascinating than any knowledge it had already accumulated.

Reflections of THE Mnemonic Leviathan, recorded during slumber within THE Seed of Observable Existence

---

As Noah continued his journey across the Three Thousand Realms of his home, he came across an entire Realm holding the composition of none other than Muspelheim.

Vibrant flames and weavings of immensity permeated throughout this region, crimson-gold authority radiating from structures that had been integrated into THE Infiniverses new architecture.

He was about to steer the boat past this Realm when he heard that heavy voice call out to him.

A certain pink dolphins tone pressed against his awareness from within the flames, lazy and unhurried as always yet somehow demanding attention regardless.

Noah smiled and steered the multicolored boat toward the fiery crimson-gold Realm.

The vessel carried him and his mother through boundaries separating configurations, crossing from the space between Realms into the heart of reformed Muspelheim itself. Heat pressed against them immediately. The flames parted as Noahs authority declared his sovereignty over everything within this domain.

A massive crimson-gold mountain dominated the center of this Realm, its slopes releasing flows of lava burning with Quintessence Infiniforce rather than simple molten rock. The liquid authority cascaded down its sides in rivers that would have dissolved anything lacking sufficient foundations, pooling at the base in lakes of concentrated power.

In the center of that lava, a crystalline crimson-gold tree irradiated immense heat that pressed against perception itself. Its branches reached toward heights that seemed infinite within this Realm, its roots drinking deep from the molten authority surrounding it. The tree pulsed with life that had nothing to do with biology and everything to do with power given vegetative form.

And basking within the lava beside that tree, lounging with laziness that seemed impossible given the environment, floated the massive form of a pink dolphin.

THE Mnemonic Leviathan.

Noah had called this ancient entity into his home so he could steal, ahem, obtain its knowledge.

The Leviathan possessed reserves of information accumulated across eons of existence.

He nodded toward the pink dolphin as his boat came to rest near the edge of the lava pool.

"Do you have something new to share? I was in the middle of profundities and epiphanies."

The Mnemonic Leviathans massive form shifted slightly within the molten authority, one eye opening to regard Noah with attention that belied its lazy posture.

"I was just dreaming about Innovators and destroyers. Contemplating which type of being would ultimately prevail across Observable Existence."

The dolphins voice rumbled through the Realm, somehow audible despite the crackling of flames all around.

"But I also had to ask something. My Progenitor has sent word to check my status. Is it acceptable to speak about where we are located?"

...!

Chapter 5038: Innovators and Destroyers II

Noah frowned at such words.

The location of his home was a secret for reasons. Overly powerful beings could not be simply told or given the coordinates of where he was.

"Who is your Progenitor? What Scale of existence are they in?"

THE Mnemonic Leviathan paused before answering, its massive form settling deeper into the lava as if the question required consideration despite having an obvious answer.

"They should be on THE Second Scale. Known as THE Beholder. A Singular Cognizance, though you may not understand what that classification means. It refers to entities that emerged during the age of nothingness before differentiation taught existence how to have boundaries. Singular Cognizances predate most of what currently lives, their perspectives shaped by observing..."

The pink dolphin had begun to ramble on with its explanation, but Noahs eyes had already widened with surprise.

THE Beholder?

THE Beholder had helped him not too long ago. He had not expected any connection between that ancient entity and this lazy, good-for-nothing pink dolphin lounging in his lava pools. Well, both loved to observe.

His eyes shone brilliantly as he interrupted the Leviathans rambling.

"How deeply are you and THE Beholder connected?"

The pink dolphin seemed almost pleased by the question.

"Few in existence inherited the weavings of the distant observer. THE Beholder seeded portions of itself across eons..."

The Leviathans voice grew more formal as it discussed its origins.

"Myself and THE Baboon of Wisdom were the only two to successfully stem from the weavings of THE Beholder. We carry portions of our Progenitors accumulated observation within our foundations, serving as extensions of its awareness across regions it cannot directly perceive."

...!

There was also a Baboon of Wisdom?

A baboon and a dolphin. Existence was truly unique in the configurations it produced.

Noah thought about this revelation for a moment. Naldine was moving with one of his bodies as she sought for them to meet a Singular Cognizance aligned with their interests. If he could have a friendly Singular Cognizance like THE Beholder potentially come to him, why not?

"Tell THE Beholder exactly where you are and who you are with."

His words emerged as command rather than request.

"Let your Progenitor know that THE Youngest has built something unprecedented within Observable Existence, and that THE Beholder is welcome to observe it firsthand."

The Mnemonic Leviathans eyes gleamed with something approaching excitement despite its lazy demeanor.

"It will be done."

Noah nodded at the confirmation before turning his attention toward the crystalline tree rising from the center of the lava pool. Its crimson-gold branches pulsed with authority accumulated since THE Hadean Emergence first triggered, a Sacred Plant that had formed alongside everything else within the reformed Infiniverse.

He emerged from the boat and walked across the surface of the lava. His mother remained behind, watching her son approach the tree with curiosity.

Noah reached the trees base and looked upward at branches spreading across heights that seemed to contain their own infinities. One particular branch caught his attention, smaller than its siblings but pulsing with intensity.

He waved his hand.

The branch separated from the tree without resistance, cutting itself free at his command and floating down toward his waiting palm. The moment his fingers closed around it, heat flooded through his awareness alongside prompts materializing before his vision.

|Item Acquired|

|Name: Ember Branch of the Hadean Tree|

|Origin: First Sacred Flora to emerge during THE Hadean Emergence within THE Seed of Observable Existence. Crystallized from concentrated Quintessence Infiniforce and primordial fire authority during the formation of the Three Thousand Realms.|

|Description: A branch severed from the Hadean Tree, containing authority sufficient to function as weapon against Civilizations at Fundamental Depth. Strikes from this branch carry primordial fire that burns foundations rather than flesh, damaging the structure of what beings have built rather than merely their physical forms. Can greatly wound Fundamental Depth entities and their Civilizations through direct contact.|

Noah smiled at the details as profundities continued swirling through his mind.

He had infused Infinities into a Sacred Herb before, and the process had allowed him to smoothly transition from Countable to Uncountable. The methodology worked. External objects could contain endless authority without suffering THE Gamaidjans corruption because they lacked consciousness to corrupt.

So what if he filled Infinity into an item like this branch?

"Flow. Flow gloriously."

He whispered calmly to the branch, his voice carrying command that reality itself would obey.

In the next moment, vibrant multicolored waves of Quintessence Infiniforce flooded from his body. The internally generated authority poured into the branch without resistance, filling its crystalline structure with endless potential that expanded rather than contained. Infinity from Observable Existence joined the Quintessence, conducted authority merging with generated authority within the branchs foundations.

The process was instant.

The process was boundless.

The process was complete before Noah could fully perceive what he had accomplished.

BOOM!

A pillar of multicolored brilliance erupted from Noahs hand, continuing upward across the entire Realm of reformed Muspelheim. The light pressed against the boundaries separating this configuration from others, declaring that something unprecedented had just occurred within THE Seed of Observable Existence.

In his hands, the branch had transformed.

It pulsed and shook with authority that seemed barely contained within its crystalline form. Auroras of Infinity symbols swirled around its length, endless loops declaring the nature of what now filled this weapon. The pressure radiating from it alone was terrifying, force leaking from its surface despite Noahs grip attempting to contain what he had created.

New prompts materialized before his vision.

|Infinity Armament Forged|

|Name: THE Hadean Infinibrand|

|Classification: First Infinity Armament forged under THE Youngest|

|Origin: Ember Branch of the Hadean Tree infused with boundless Quintessence Infiniforce and conducted Infinity from Observable Existence. Represents the first successful integration of endless authority into weaponized form.|

|Primary Capability: Can infinitely strike any Civilization with equivalent force that most Absolute Depth entities cannot withstand. Each strike carries the full pressure of Infinity compressed into physical impact, damaging foundations in ways that regeneration cannot easily address.|

|Secondary Capability: Can only be wielded by someone possessing understanding of or relation to Infinity. Beings lacking such connection will find the Armament refusing their grasp, its authority rejecting those unworthy of conducting what it contains.|

|Tertiary Capability: Endlessly generates Infinity within its structure, accumulating authority that can be unleashed all at once for strikes vastly exceeding normal output. The longer the Armament is held without attacking, the greater the force of its eventual release.|

|Limitation: Minimal effectiveness against anything at THE Proterozoic Scale.|

Noah looked at his latest innovation, THE Hadean Infinibrand pulsing in his grip as Infinity continued generating within its crystalline form.

He nodded slowly.

Naldine had told him much about THE Proterozoic Scale, about the methodologies those beings employed and the transformations they underwent to wield Infinity safely. The gap was fundamental rather than quantitative.
