Noah grasped THE Hadean Spear of Civilization in his hand as he floated down gently toward the golden sands.

The grains cradled his figure when he landed, settling around his feet as if welcoming him back to solid ground. He put his other hand on his chest and sensed the terrifying pressure of THE Hadean Organ of Civilization pulsing within, its presence now unmistakable in ways it hadnt been before the transformation. The organ had gained new capabilities.

The prison within him had changed.

Civilizational Eons of Development would now be generated through THE Hadean Organ of Civilization. One had already passed during the initial transformation, accelerating everything within THE Hadean Desmoterion beyond what normal time dilation could achieve. He had one more available. And he could utilize it to have his imprisoned self within him take that step and become a Second Scale existence.

With existence being so vast and full of terrors, this wasnt something he would ever deny.

"Utilize the Civilizational Eon of Development."

He spoke the command lightly, as if ordering a meal rather than triggering a transformation that would reshape part of his own existence.

HUUM!

Prompts bloomed before his vision immediately.

|Command Accepted|

|The remaining Civilizational Eon of Development has been utilized.|

|THE Hadean Organ of Civilization is carrying out prolific, comprehensive, and quintessential advancement within THE Hadean Desmoterion. An entire eon will pass within the next ten seconds. Results will be displayed upon completion.|

|Time Remaining: 10 seconds|

...!

Noah smiled brilliantly at the words.

Ten seconds out here. An entire eon in there. His other self would have lifetimes to accomplish what needed accomplishing while Noah barely had time to examine what hed already gained.

He proceeded to grasp his spear properly and look at it while the seconds began to tick down.

The weapon felt light within his hands despite carrying the terrifying power of his Infiniverses Observable and Unobservable weavings multiplied by a factor of ten and then raised by an exponent of three.

The spear responded to his grip as if it weighed nothing at all. The crystalline shaft hummed against his palms, resonating with his heartbeat in ways that made him feel like the weapon had always been part of him.

He needed to get a feel for it.

Noah raised the spear above his head and swung it down once in a simple vertical arc.

The motion began slowly, almost lazily, the crystalline weapon cutting through air that suddenly felt thick with potential. As the spearhead descended, something emerged around the shaft that made Noahs eyes widen with genuine surprise.

Two rivers of misty light began swirling around the weapon.

The first river was clear, almost invisible, perceptible only through the way it bent light around itself. It moved like smoke given purpose, coiling around the spears shaft in patterns that seemed to follow rules Noah couldnt immediately identify.

This force felt cold in ways that had nothing to do with temperature, pressing against his awareness with the sensation of everything that existed beyond perceptions reach.

The Unobservable.

The second river blazed with golden luminosity that painted the Early Veiled Shore in hues of captured sunlight. It wound around the spear in configurations opposite to its clear counterpart, the two forces spiraling together without ever quite touching.

This force felt warm and present, the accumulated acknowledgment of everything that could be witnessed pressing outward with intensity that demanded recognition.

The Observable.

Both rivers danced around his descending spear as if existence itself had decided to manifest its fundamental division through his weapon. Clear and gold, hidden and seen, unknown and known, the two forces representing everything that Proterozoic Scale beings pulled into themselves to forge their transformations. He was watching the nature of Second Scale power made visible around a weapon that shouldnt exist.

His seemingly simple swing stopped midway through its arc.

The rivers of clear and gold didnt stop with it.

BOOM!

The force continued forward without the spear to guide it.

Utter devastation unfolded before Noahs eyes as the golden sands in front of him split down the middle. A canyon carved itself into the Early Veiled Shore, reaching deeper than the sands should have extended, revealing layers of existence beneath that hed never seen. The sacred waters of the shores ahead parted like curtains being drawn aside, liquid authority separating into two halves that continued moving apart as the force traveled beyond them.

Light years away, the shimmering barrier protecting the Early Veiled Shore from the rest of THE Infiniverse tore open!

The force of a single incomplete swing had crossed distances, ripping through protections designed to keep his farms safe from everything outside them. Beyond that barrier, Noah sensed the damage continuing, the rivers of Observable and Unobservable force pressing toward one of the Three Thousand Realms with momentum that showed no signs of stopping!

His expression went somber immediately.

Noah clenched his free hand and pulled, his will reaching out to grasp the escaping force and dissipate it before it could tear through an entire Realm hed just created. The clear and golden rivers resisted for a moment, wanting to continue their path of destruction, before finally dissolving into harmless particles of light that scattered across the void.

"..."

He breathed out calmly and looked down at the terrifying weapon in his hand.

One swing. Not even a complete swing. Just the beginning of a vertical arc, stopped halfway through, and the resulting force had nearly destroyed a Realm while tearing across light years of distance. This was a catastrophe shaped like a spear, devastation given form that could be directed but would require extreme care to control!

As he was holding it, processing what had just happened, he began to feel something else.

His own body started emanating terrifying waves of power that pressed outward in pulses matching his heartbeat. His immensity, which hed already thought was reaching unheard of heights, was rising even further. This change came from within, his Organ of Civilization pulsing with glory as something completed itself in THE Hadean Desmoterion.

The ten seconds had passed.

New prompts bloomed before his vision.

|Civilizational Eon of Development: Complete|

|Progress Report: OZYMANDIAS|

|Phase One: Civilizational Anchor Establishment|

|Duration: First half of Civilizational Eon|

|Ozymandias utilized his profound foundation, refined across the previous Civilizational Eon of Development, to establish his Civilizational Anchor. The absolute self-knowledge required for this process was achieved through introspection spanning centuries of dilated time. Every aspect of his existence was examined, understood, and crystallized into certainty that could not be shaken.|

|Result: Civilizational Anchor successfully established. Ozymandias has grasped THE Proterozoic Scale of Existence. Your alternate self now exists at THE Second Scale.|

|Phase Two: Proterozoic Transformation Attempt|

|Duration: Latter half of Civilizational Eon|

|With the Civilizational Anchor established, Ozymandias utilized the remaining time to attempt the formation of a Proterozoic Organ or Bone. Materials available within THE Hadean Desmoterion, combined with the Observable and Unobservable weavings permeating THE Hadean Organ of Civilization, were employed in this process.|

|Result: In Progress. Transformation has begun.|

|A Civilizational Eons worth of experiences awaits your review.|

...!

Noah smiled brilliantly as he felt the terrifying changes resonating through his existence.

Due to the dilated time governing his prison, he could peek into the memories of Ozymandias whenever he chose to. Every moment of that eon, every struggle and breakthrough and revelation his other self had experienced, all of it waited for him to observe. He now had a Civilizational Eons worth of memories to sift through at his leisure.

More importantly, he could feel just what had happened to his other self.

Ozymandias had taken the step forward.

A portion of his existence now operated at THE Proterozoic Scale, and it felt...immense!

Chapter 5049: A Warning

While one man made a modest advancement in THE Infiniverse.

Heavy rainfall bloomed across the Wastes in rivers of multicolored brilliance that transformed everything they touched.

The region that had earned its name through desolation and emptiness was changing. Where barren expanses had stretched for light years, new formations emerged from the saturated ground. Structures of crystallized authority rose from spaces that hadnt produced anything in eons.

The Pluvial Epoch of Existential Infinity was rewriting this corner of Observable Existence, and soon the Wastes might no longer deserve their name at all.

Through this transforming landscape moved a massive figure.

Beowulf, THE Primordial Armor, walked with his enormous hammer resting against one shoulder, each step pressing craters into ground too weak to support his passage.

His invisible expression was thoughtful beneath the helmet that had become part of his existence, contemplating changes that affected plans hed spent eons developing. The rainfall couldnt touch him directly, his corrupted glory deflecting the multicolored drops before they could land on his armored form.

Then he came to a stop and looked out into the distance.

His helmet turned toward something appearing on the horizon, something that shouldnt have been possible given the distances involved.

Across the Wastes, a massive illusory form materialized against the transformed space.

A titan wreathed in flames towered over the landscape, humanoid in shape but vast beyond mortal comprehension. The figure burned with authority that pressed against everything perceiving it, fire that consumed nothing but illuminated everything. It was an illusory image of...THE Creature!

THE Creature sat upon a makeshift throne of condensed existence, leaning back with a posture suggesting absolute dominion over everything within his sight.

Rivers of unique power surged across his body in configurations that defied classification, authority flowing through him in patterns that declared his position among the apex of Observable Existence. His flames burned brighter where the multicolored rain fell upon them, consuming the Pluvial Epochs effects as fuel rather than submitting to their transformative nature.

In both hands, he held something that made Beowulfs armored body vibrate with shock.

Eyes.

Massive crimson eyes, each one larger than realms, rested in THE Creatures grip like trophies claimed from a defeated enemy. These were the eyes that had formed across the Wastes to put countless beings under their control, the instruments through which influence had spread.

The Eyes of Horus.

But at this moment, those eyes were bloody and torn and ruptured. They stood lifeless in THE Creatures hands, their crimson light extinguished, their power ended. Whatever conflict had occurred between THE Creature and Horus, the outcome was now being displayed for all of existence to witness.

Beowulf stared at this image as his massive armored body continued vibrating, frequencies of agitation running through foundations that rarely experienced uncertainty.

But he wasnt the only one privy to this scene.

In all regions across the Wastes, the illusory image appeared simultaneously. In Prima Indifferentia, where ancient beings stirred in domains theyd occupied since before differentiation. In Primordial Realms scattered throughout Observable Existence, where Architects and Terrors and Undivided Ones now moved in and conducted their endless pursuits.

In every corner where the awareness and gazes of powerful beings at the First and Second Scale permeated, the grand illusory visage of THE Creature holding the lifeless Eyes of Horus manifested.

He didnt say anything.

His bearing and posture spoke clearly enough without words. The way he sat upon that throne, the casual grip with which he held eyes that had terrorized regions, the flames burning around him with intensity that suggested this display cost him nothing, all of it communicated a singular message to those rising across Observable Existence.

Behave.

In Prima Indifferentia, the image of THE Creature appeared against space that hadnt seen clear light since before most current beings existed.

Moments later, the deluge of rivers and multicolored rain parted.

A crack opened in the fabric of this ancient realm, splitting silently like a wound appearing in flesh that had forgotten it could be cut. Two obsidian hands emerged from the darkness within that crack, fingers curling around the edges as if they were unveiling pages of a book rather than tearing through the barriers between spaces.

The hands pulled the crack wider.

From the widened opening, an obsidian face poked out to observe the illusory image of THE Creature displayed across Prima Indifferentias transformed skies.

The head was stellar obsidian given humanoid form, darkness so complete that it seemed to absorb the multicolored light falling all around. A single obsidian horn emerged from the center of its forehead, curving upward in configurations that suggested crown more than weapon. The features beneath were sharp and ancient.

But the entire head and that single horn shone with a distinct light.

Proterozoic light.

When the illusory flames of THE Creature reflected against that obsidian skull, the bones beneath became visible through the darkness. They blazed with brilliance declaring their nature to anyone capable of perceiving it.

The skull itself was a Proterozoic Bone, transformed through methodologies that most beings couldnt survive. That single horn was another Proterozoic Bone, authority crystallized into physical form through processes spanning eons of careful cultivation.

This was a Second Scale existence observing THE Creatures warning.

The obsidian face watched the image of those ruined eyes held in THE Creatures grip. It studied the casual dominance displayed in that seated posture, the declaration of supremacy being broadcast across all of Observable Existence.

Then it smiled.

The expression was brutal and glorious, teeth of stellar obsidian catching Proterozoic light as lips pulled back in appreciation rather than fear. This being looked at THE Creatures terrifying displayed feat and found it amusing. Found it exciting. Found it worthy of response!

Laughter erupted from that obsidian throat.

The sound stretched outward from the crack in Prima Indifferentia, carrying across distances that light would need eons to traverse. Gigaparsecs of space trembled as that laughter rolled through them, the amusement of a Proterozoic Scale existence declaring its reaction to THE Creatures warning.

The laughter didnt stop.

It echoed across Prima Indifferentia long after the obsidian face retreated back into the crack from which it had emerged, the sound continuing to resonate through transformed landscapes and ancient domains.

THE Creatures warning had been delivered, but not everyone who received it was intimidated.

Chapter 5050: Vengeance I

The Xenoturbella is a marine organism with no brain, no gut, no organs of any kind.

It has one hole. Food enters through this hole. Waste exits through the same hole. It drifts along the ocean floor consuming whatever it bumps into, existing for no clear reason or purpose that scientists have ever determined. Evolution produced it and then apparently forgot about it.

Somehow, THE Living Elemental was lesser than such an existence.

The Xenoturbella at least committed to its simplicity. It never pretended to be more than a tube with ambitions limited to its next meal. THE Living Elemental reached for greatness, achieved Absolute depths at THE First Scale, accumulated authority that should have meant something, and still managed to contribute less to Observable Existence than a creature whose entire biological strategy was "have hole."

At least the Xenoturbella never disappointed anyone.

At least the Xenoturbella never failed upward into imprisonment.

At least the Xenoturbella, in its humble way, knew exactly what it was and never aspired to become something its foundations couldnt support.

THE Living Elemental could learn much from such an organism.

Unfortunately, learning required a capacity for growth that THE Living Elemental had never demonstrated.

-Commentary discovered in THE Hadean Desmoterions administrative records, author confirmed to be Ozymandias during a moment of particular irritation

---

The memories of Ozymandias flittered through Noahs mind as he assumed active control of this body and extended his awareness into THE Hadean Desmoterion.

Endless days of peaceful cultivation stretched through his perception. He experienced centuries of patient accumulation, the gradual saturation of foundations with Quintessence Infiniforce, the methodical integration of Observable and Unobservable weavings into an existence preparing for transformation. Then came the establishment of THE Civilizational Anchor, that moment when his other self crystallized absolute certainty regarding what he was and what he would never compromise.

The affirmations echoed through him now, words that Ozymandias had spoken into the void of the prison while forging an identity that could not be shaken.

"Hunger is not weakness. Hunger is the only honest truth in existence."

"Everything consumes. Everything devours. Everything feeds. Those who deny this lie to themselves while their foundations cannibalize their potential."

"I am Hunger given form. I am the acknowledgment that existence itself is predation. I do not apologize for what I am. I do not pretend to be something gentler. I consume because consumption is the fundamental act of being, and I have simply ceased pretending otherwise."

"My Anchor is Hunger. My Anchor is truth. My Anchor cannot be moved because Hunger cannot be eliminated from existence itself. And my Hunger...is Infinite."

Noah opened his eyes to observe THE Hadean Desmoterion spread before him.

The body of Ozymandias possessed qualities distinct from his main form. Titanic and muscular, its surface shone stellar obsidian mixed with crimson brilliance that pulsed with rhythms matching a heartbeat far slower than any mortal organ could produce.

He took a single step and crossed light years instantaneously.

Ozymandias materialized upon the mountain where THE Living Elemental meditated, his titanic obsidian form casting shadows across the swirling elemental meteors. The prisoners eyes opened immediately, perceiving the arrival of something that should not have been possible within this prison.

THE Living Elemental appeared as a being composed of the four classical forces given humanoid shape. Fire blazed along one arm while water flowed along the other. Earth formed his torso in configurations of living stone, and air swirled around his head in winds that never ceased moving. His features held terror now, recognizing the body standing before him.

Noah did not permit him to finish.

Ozymandiass right leg rose with speed that should not have been possible for something so massive, and the sole of his foot connected with THE Living Elementals chest.

BOOM!

The impact sent the prisoner cratering into the mountain beneath him, stone and crystal shattering outward in rings of devastation. Before Elemental could recover, Noahs left leg descended in a stomp that drove the fool deeper into the ruined terrain. Fire and water scattered from the prisoners form as his elemental composition struggled to maintain coherence under the assault.

Noah kicked him again.

And again.

Each impact drove THE Living Elemental further into broken ground, his screams echoing across the region as meteors of his own elements spun chaotically overhead. Noah experienced no particular satisfaction from this action. It was not about satisfaction. It was about justice for a day he would never forget!

His final kick connected with Elementals midsection and launched the prisoner light years across THE Hadean Desmoterion.

The trajectory concluded when Elemental collided with a distant mountain, the impact visible as a flash of light against the cosmic backdrop of the prisons impossible geography.

Noah exhaled slowly.

He felt somewhat improved.

This was a shameful moment, admittedly. Petty in ways that did not befit the image of THE Genesis Monarch conducting Infinity across Observable Existence.

However, this occurred inside his own existence with no one to observe, and what THE Living Elemental had done remained unforgivable regardless of how much time elapsed.

Certain grudges deserved to be maintained!

Chapter 5051: Vengeance II

Someone strong enough to compel this Proterozoic Limb toward revealing its capabilities.

Who precisely would be sufficient to permit him a satisfactory confrontation while also not being defeated in a one-sided manner?

"..."

---

|This capability exceeds simple mimicry. You do not merely copy but you comprehend, integrate, and express Civilizations as though they were always part of your foundations.|

BOOM!

The prompts were substantial ones, and Noahs eyes spun gloriously as he processed their implications.

Around his body, the clear and golden misty forces of Unobservable and Observable began to swirl without his conscious direction. The clear river coiled around his left side, that vast darkness beyond perception responding to his Organs transformation. The golden river wrapped around his right side, the accumulated acknowledgment of everything witnessed declaring its presence alongside its counterpart.

...!

Noahs eyes shone brilliantly at the set of prompts flashing before him.

Astonishment crossed his features as he looked out across the Early Veiled Shore.

His gaze traveled further, extending past the vast and nigh endless Infiniverse into the outside landscape where rivers and seas of the Pluvial Epoch of Existential Infinity spread through Observable Existence. The multicolored rain continued falling across regions his authority had touched, transforming everything it contacted while declaring his influence to anyone capable of perceiving it.

That massive titan wreathed in flames sat upon a makeshift throne, posture radiating dominion over everything within sight. In both hands, he gripped crimson eyes that had terrorized regions for eons, now bloody and torn and ruptured beyond repair. The message being broadcast required no words to comprehend.

Horus had fallen.

Behave, or face the same fate.

Noah smiled at the image before returning his attention to the selection of his three targets. THE Creatures display had reminded him of something important.

Power in Observable Existence was not merely accumulated. It was demonstrated. It was declared. It was shown to those who might otherwise forget that certain beings should not be challenged.

His Hadean Coalescence would permit him to grow through methodology his enemies could not perceive.

<The Parable of THE Hollowing Witness>

In Prima Indifferentia, there exists a creature known as THE Hollowing Witness.

It does not hunt or chase. It does not announce itself through roars or displays of dominance that might alert its prey to approaching danger. THE Hollowing Witness simply watches from distances its targets cannot perceive, observing through senses that operate outside the boundaries of normal awareness.

While it watches, it feeds.

Not on anything the observed entity would notice missing until far too late. THE Hollowing Witness consumes potential.

It devours futures that have not yet occurred, digesting possibilities its targets would have otherwise achieved. Every moment of observation removes something from the prey that they never knew they possessed.

A being observed for a single day loses nothing significant. A being observed for a year loses opportunities they would have dismissed as bad luck. A being observed for a century begins to wonder why their cultivation has slowed, why breakthroughs that should have arrived remain perpetually out of reach, why existence itself seems to resist their advancement.

A being observed for an eon discovers they have become hollow without ever understanding how.

There is a tale told among the Undivided Ones of Prima Indifferentia regarding a Formless Terror who grew suspicious of his stagnation. He had cultivated diligently for millennia. He had consumed resources that should have elevated him beyond his current state. Yet he remained precisely where he had been when his efforts began, as though running in place while believing himself to be sprinting forward.

He searched for enemies. He found none.

He searched for curses. He discovered nothing.

He searched for parasites feeding upon his foundations. His existence was clean.

Only when he was moments from dissolution, his potential entirely consumed, did he finally perceive THE Hollowing Witness observing him from a distance his weakened senses could barely register. The creature had been watching for longer than the Formless Terror had been aware of his own stagnation. Every future he might have claimed had already been digested. Every height he might have reached had already been stolen.

The Formless Terror screamed a single question before his existence collapsed into nothing.

"Why me?"

THE Hollowing Witness did not answer, for it had already turned its attention toward new prey.

The parable concludes with a truth that those in Prima Indifferentia understand intimately: the most dangerous predators are not those who face you in battle. They are those who have already won before you realize the conflict has begun. By the time you stand before them, you have already lost everything that might have permitted victory.

You simply have not noticed yet.

Chapter 5052: Vengeance III

The figure of Alexander appeared on the Early Veiled Shore, stepping through folds of space that recognized him as welcome within this domain.

Noah turned toward his arrival and nodded in acknowledgment before waving his hand toward the skies above. Reality responded to his gesture, and the image of THE Creature holding the lifeless Eyes of Horus materialized against the backdrop of the Early Veiled Shore. That massive titan wreathed in flames now blazed above the golden sands, his trophy displayed for Alexander to witness just as it was being displayed across all of Observable Existence.

Noah turned to Alexander as he spoke.

"Even Second Scale Primordial Architects like Horus are not untouchable. You likely had him among those you would seek vengeance against in the future, but he is now taken care of."

His eyes studied Alexanders reaction carefully.

"How do you feel about the one who tortured you?"

...!

Noah observed Alexander as Alexander looked back at him.

The man appeared different from when Noah had last examined him closely. He seemed taller than before, his frame more robust as though his foundations had expanded to fill space they previously could not occupy. A green robe adorned his figure, the material flowing with quality that suggested authority woven into its threads. But the most striking change rotated upon his chest.

A vibrant Enneagram shone there, nine points connected by lines that blazed with multicolored gems embedded at each intersection. The symbol rotated like a wheel against his sternum, its movement steady and purposeful. His expression held grandeur that had not been present before his torture, as though suffering had refined something within him rather than diminishing it.

He looked at the image of the lifeless Horus as his eyes blazed brighter, and he simply clenched his fists before he unclenched and breathed out.

"Ashes to ashes, dust to dust."

WAA!

Alexanders voice emerged with conviction that matched his transformed appearance.

"I was actually about to come and ask you something. I do not want to wait too long."

He paused, gathering words that clearly cost him something to speak.

"I followed the paths that only Second Scale Existences know. I have reforged my existence so that just as he was able to hurt me through what only he could see, I should be able to hurt him just the same."

His jaw tightened.

"But I know that alone will not be enough. So I have... to ask for help."

He met Noahs eyes directly.

"Please. Help me. Help me...collapse Beowulf."

...!

BOOM!

A man asking for help from another man was a rare occurrence in existence.

Whenever any man found himself hurting, he rarely turned to another for assistance. He would exhaust every option available through his own power, attempt every solution his own mind could conceive, push himself to the absolute boundaries of what his foundations could sustain before even considering the possibility of reaching out. That was how so many men became destroyed and collapsed into obscurity. They never asked for help. Sometimes it was not even a matter of pride.

Sometimes it was simply that they did not know how.

The words felt foreign in their mouths. The vulnerability seemed like weakness rather than wisdom. The admission that they could not accomplish something alone felt like failure rather than an honest assessment. They had been taught, through countless experiences and observations, that strength meant self-sufficiency.

That real men handled their problems without burdening others. That asking for help was the first step toward being seen as lesser.

These were lies that killed more men than any enemy ever could.

There were many reasons not to ask for help. Noah understood this intimately. But Alexander had come forward regardless of those reasons, had spoken the words despite their difficulty, had requested assistance even knowing how it might appear.

Noah would give that help freely.

Nor would he ever make Alexander feel bad or lesser for asking.

One should always feel permitted to ask for help. Whether you possessed family or someone you considered a friend, you should never be afraid to reach out.

In existence, you were never alone.

The isolation that convinced men they had to face everything by themselves was another lie, perhaps the cruelest one of all.

Noah rose and placed his hand on Alexanders shoulder.

"Come on. Let us go find Beowulf."

His grip tightened with reassurance.

"He is on a whole different Scale compared to us, but hey..."

A smile crossed his features.

"While there will not be the power of friendship suddenly rising up to save the day, I have a very, very sharp spear."

HUUM!

As Noah spoke these words, incandescent stellar blue rivers of Infinity began surging from above.

The authority descended like waterfalls of condensed potential, gathering before Noah and Alexander in configurations that twisted space into new arrangements. The rivers wove together, braiding themselves into an archway that solidified into a doorway blazing with endless blue light. Through that threshold, distances that would require eons to traverse became single steps.

Many wanted to find him across Observable Existence.

But with the Pluvial Epoch of Existential Infinity and his spread of Infinity everywhere, it was very easy for him to find others instead. His authority had saturated regions throughout Observable Existence. His weavings permeated spaces that enemies thought were hidden. If someone existed within range of his Infinitys touch, he could locate them.

This doorway would lead them directly to Beowulf.

"Oh, before that..."

Noah stopped for a moment, his attention turning inward toward his Organ of Civilization. A thought crystallized into command as he spoke aloud.

"Set the targets for Hadean Existential Singularities to be Beowulf and THE Living Paradox."

HUUM!

His Organ of Civilization began to spin with terrific glow, multicolored light blazing from his chest as the mechanism within processed his designation. The clear and golden rivers of Unobservable and Observable force swirled around his form in response, acknowledging the targets he had selected.

Prompts bloomed before his vision.

|Connection Strength: Significant. Decent confrontations and conflicts have established substantial existential resonance between your foundations.|

|Siphoning Efficiency: Medium due to Scale differential. Hadean Existential Singularities will be extracted at a normal rate.|

---

|Connection Strength: Profound. Historical relationship creates deep existential resonance that enhances extraction efficiency.|

Noah observed the prompts with satisfaction before dismissing them from his vision.

Two of his three slots were now filled with beings who had earned their positions through enmity. Beowulf would contribute to Noahs understanding of THE Proterozoic Scale whether he wished to or not. THE Living Paradox...he seemed to still be more than what many believed!

The third slot he would reserve for now.

Noah stepped toward the doorway blazing with stellar blue Infinity, his form approaching the threshold that would carry them directly to a dangerous being at THE Second Scale.

Alexander followed behind him without fear.

In his eyes there burned a deadly light, the illumination of peace he had to establish regardless of the cost. It did not matter how badly a Primordial Architect had to bleed for that peace to be achieved. It did not matter what Alexander himself might suffer in the pursuit. Beowulf had broken something within him, and the only way to repair that damage was to face the one who had caused it.

Chapter 5053: Acceleration I

While two men crossed weavings of Infinities to go seek a Primordial Architect...

The isolated region of Jotunheim had transformed beyond recognition.

Seas of multicolored brilliance from the Pluvial Epoch of Existential Infinity had gathered in basins that previously held nothing but ice and desolation. A citadel emerged from these accumulated waters, its structure crystallized from condensed authority that the epoch had deposited across the landscape.

THE Living Temporal sat in a meditative position before this transformed citadel, ancient rivers of time flowing around his figure in configurations that bent perception.

Amser Modred appeared as a man both old and young simultaneously, his features shifting between ages depending on which angle observed them. Dignity and grace permeated his bearing despite the casual nature of his seated posture.

His robes flowed with temporal currents that made their fabric appear frozen and moving at the same instant.

He possessed Bounded Countable Infinity now, granted to him by THE Youngest through bonds of servitude that had proven far more generous than expected.

His existence was currently exuberant, all his eons of progress culminating heavily as a daring idea crystallized within his awareness. He was actually contemplating forming his Anchor. The Civilizational Anchor that THE Second Scale demanded, the absolute self-knowledge that permitted transition beyond THE First Scale into heights he had spent lifetimes believing were beyond his reach.

THE Youngest made impossible things possible with Infinity. Why not him as well?

Perhaps he and many others required only the courage to follow Osmonts lead. After all, Osmont had not gone mad with Infinity just yet.

As he contemplated these possibilities, rivers of Temporal Infinity coalesced behind him.

The multicolored currents flowed toward THE Secretive Eon, who had been examining herself since regaining consciousness. She stood apart from the others, her dark eyes fixed upon hands that had recently been controlled by something other than her own will.

THE Primordial Mycelia had used her existence as a puppet, and the memory of that violation pressed against her awareness with a force that demanded response.

Behind Amser, Abaddon sat touching his chest with blank expression.

This guy was still reeling. His fingers pressed against his sternum as though searching for something that should have been there, something so fundamental to his identity that its absence made him question whether he still existed at all.

At this time, a determined expression finally formed on the face of THE Secretive Eon.

She cracked her neck with sharp motion, the sound echoing across the transformed landscape. Authority flashed across her body in waves of illumination that pressed against everything nearby. Her robe shifted from whatever state it had held before into pristine white that seemed to reject any stain or imperfection. Her dark hair shimmered with light that came from within rather than reflecting from without.

She turned toward the absent-minded figure of Abaddon.

Her hand shot out and grasped his neck before he could react, her fingers closing around flesh that offered no resistance. She lifted him slightly, forcing his blank eyes to meet her cold gaze.

"I planned to destroy and then hold all the Keys of Civilizations, starting with you."

Her voice emerged frigid and grand, each word carrying conviction refined across her existence.

"You would have been the stepping point for me to go after Erwin, to determine if I even possessed a chance against THE Creature. But you go and lose your Claim?"

Her grip tightened.

"Were you not supposed to be the oldest of the Claimers? You fucking loser."

BOOM!

Her words pressed against the transformed landscape as her gaze burned with coldness that would have made lesser beings flinch.

Yet Abaddon did not even react. He simply observed her with absent expression, his eyes holding nothing but the emptiness where Chaos had once resided!

Her fury meant nothing to him. Her threats meant nothing to him. The loss of his Claim had taken something from his existence that made everything else irrelevant.

Amser Modred turned around and frowned at the scene unfolding behind him.

"Leave him be. Even with a lost Claim, he is still..."

He rose and moved to separate the two as he spoke, his temporal authority gathering around him in preparation for intervention. Before he could complete either his sentence or his action, something unexpected occurred.

THE Secretive Eon used her other hand.

It shone with terrifying light, power concentrated into a strike that moved faster than Amsers temporal perception could process. The blow connected with his chest and launched him backward with force that should not have been possible from someone he had considered roughly his equal or lesser!

Amser smashed into the multicolored seas nearby, his form creating waves of displaced authority that rippled outward in all directions. He tumbled through the liquid brilliance until friction finally brought him to a stop, his body half-submerged in waters that soaked through his temporal robes.

He looked up in shock at what had just occurred.

THE Secretive Eon continued staring at Abaddon without acknowledging Amsers displacement.

"Emotive took your Claim? The one you and Paradox and THE Creature have been using for pleasure all these eons?"

Her voice dripped with contempt.

"Big fucking men in power, and a loose woman brings you down like this? Maddening."

She was furious for reasons that extended beyond just simple frustration.

Something she had been planning to do before her existence was controlled by another had already been accomplished by someone else.

The destruction of the Keys of Civilizations and replacement had been her purpose. Her goal.

And now someone she had not even considered significant had accomplished what she intended before she could even attempt it.

THE Living Emotive, that manic creature obsessed with emotions, had stripped Chaos from someone THE Secretive Eon had marked as her first target.

She shook her head and tightened her grip on Abaddon.

At this moment, a deep voice boomed out from above.

"Woah, I do not sense any weavings of Unity anymore. Did that fellow work so quickly while I was getting my ass handed to me?"

"Eon, is that you?"

...!

THE Primordial Paradox descended from heights that seemed infinite, his obsidian titanic body shining with blue and gold light that pressed against the transformed landscape of Jotunheim. Paradox burned around him brilliantly, that contradictory authority declaring his nature to anyone capable of perceiving it. He was massive and ancient and dangerous!

Eon met his gaze without releasing Abaddon, her grip remaining tight around his neck.

After a moment of consideration, she permitted her fingers to open.

Abaddon slumped to the ground without acknowledging his release.

"Mmm. I have to thank Osmont, even though I promised to hunt him after I was done with others."

Her voice emerged thoughtful rather than grateful.

THE Primordial Paradox smiled at her words, amusement flickering across his obsidian features.

"I do not think you will be able to do that."

He descended lower, his massive form coming to rest upon the transformed landscape.

"But no matter. You appear to be getting left behind here. Do you want to take that step to form your Anchor? I can help you out if you help me with your Civilization."

...!

His words were substantial ones. THE Secretive Eon scowled at the implication that she required assistance.

She looked up at him and spoke.

"Has your disciple grasped THE Second Scale already? That will make it difficult for me to do anything against him."

THE Primordial Paradox smiled more broadly at her concern.

"He possessed that power already. Oh, and he has a Singular Cognizance and likely Primordial Architects he has allied with, so you alone may not be able to do much."

His obsidian form shifted with amusement.

"You were already working with Osmont, yes? Just consider this an extension."

...!

His words were grand as THE Secretive Eon contemplated what he offered.

She thought for a moment before releasing a sigh of resignation.

Her gaze fell upon Abaddon one final time, distaste visible in her expression as she observed the broken figure who had once been the oldest of the Keys of Civilizations. Then she took a step and disappeared from Jotunheim entirely, her existence folding through spaces that carried her toward where she would have THE Primordial Paradox follow.

Chapter 5054: Acceleration II

THE Primordial Paradox smiled at her departure before his attention shifted.

He gazed with something approaching sadness toward Abaddon, whose body had begun to drift listlessly upon the multicolored sea. The currents of the Pluvial Epoch carried him away from the citadel, away from the others, away from everything that had once defined his existence as one of the most significant beings in Observable Existence.

Chaos was gone.

What remained was merely flesh that had forgotten how to care about its own continuation.

THE Primordial Paradox nodded toward Amser Modred, who remained drenched in multicolored rain where he had risen from the seas.

Acknowledgment passed between them before THE Primordial Paradox disappeared as well, his obsidian form folding away through spaces!

Amser Modred observed the body of Abaddon floating away on the transformed waters.

He shook his head and released a frustrated sigh, temporal authority rippling around him in response to his emotional state.

Everything was changing too quickly. Alliances formed and dissolved. Powers shifted between beings who had held them for eons. The stability that had governed Observable Existence was crumbling, and new configurations were emerging that would reshape everything.

His eyes burned with temporal determination as epiphany crystallized within his awareness.

"Everyones path is different. The time it takes...is different."

He spoke aloud to no one but himself.

"Someone like Osmont can advance at a fraction of time compared to others because he possesses Infinity. Time dilates around those who hold endless potential, compressing what should require eons into what occurs within moments. The temporal advancements bend around his existence like... light bending around a star."

His form began to shimmer with temporal authority gathering into configurations he had never attempted before.

"And now this Infinity is shared with many. Will the time it took to advance infinitely not be cut short? If Bounded Countable Infinity flows through my foundations, does time not become malleable in ways it was not before?"

Rivers of temporal energy coalesced around his figure, ancient currents responding to revelations forming within his consciousness.

"Temporal Infinities. Infinite time. These are...They are methodologies I can employ."

His eyes blazed brighter as the truth settled into his foundations.

"My Anchor is established across time rather than within a single moment. I will seek it not in the present but across all moments simultaneously. I have sought it across time already. I should have obtained it across time. The seeking and the obtaining, the past and the future, they...are the same when time becomes infinite."

BOOM!

With such words, Amser Modred disappeared into a temporal multicolored river that commenced extending infinitely across Jotunheim and beyond!

The current stretched through moments that had already occurred and moments that had not yet arrived, reaching into temporal configurations that defied linear understanding. It spread beyond Jotunheims boundaries into the greater expanse of Observable Existence, carrying THE Living Temporal toward a Civilizational Anchor established not within time but across it!

His paradoxical pursuit had commenced.

And time itself would determine whether his epiphany held truth or merely the comfortable lie of a being desperate to believe advancement remained possible.

---

Abaddon floated listlessly upon the seas caused by the Pluvial Epoch of Existential Infinity.

The multicolored waters flowed around his body, into his body, through his body. He did not bother to stop the currents from permeating his existence. He did not bother to resist the transformation they offered. He simply drifted, carried by forces he no longer possessed the will to acknowledge, his eyes staring upward at skies painted with colors he could not bring himself to care about.

On and on he drifted.

The waters carried him past crystallized formations that the epoch had grown from nothing. They carried him past shores where new life emerged.

They carried him through regions of Jotunheim that had once answered to his command, territories where his Claim of Chaos had made him absolute.

None of it mattered anymore.

Until something shifted beneath the surface.

The multicolored seas began to churn around his floating form, currents disrupting in patterns. Massive shapes rose from the depths, shadows ascending through brilliance that should have made them invisible. They emerged slowly, deliberately, with purpose that pressed against the listless despair surrounding Abaddons existence.

Chaos Giants.

They arose from the waters in groups of five, then ten, then dozens. Their massive forms towered over the seas as they gathered around the drifting body of Abaddon, their features ancient and terrible and filled with something that appeared remarkably like reverence.

They remembered their king!

Massive hands reached beneath Abaddons floating form and lifted him from the waters with gentleness that contradicted their enormous strength. They raised him above the multicolored seas as if carrying a fallen monarch, their grips supporting his body. His head rested upon one giants palm while others supported his torso and limbs.

Abaddons eyes shook for the first time since losing his Claim.

He stared at the Chaos Giants surrounding him, at faces he had commanded for eons, at beings who should have abandoned him the moment his authority departed. They had no reason to serve him now. They had no obligation to acknowledge his existence. The Claim of Chaos that had bound them to his will was gone!

Yet here they were.

The Chaos Giants smiled at him, expressions of warmth crossing features designed for terror.

They simply carried him away from the drifting currents, away from the listless despair that had claimed him, toward destinations known only to those native to this realm.

One Chaos Giant stopped to observe this procession commandingly...as if he was literally the one commanding all this.

He stood apart from the others, his massive form half-submerged in the multicolored seas as he watched his brethren carry their fallen king. A smile crossed his terrible features, but something about that expression did not match the reverence displayed by the others.

From his mouth, a voice echoed that did not belong to him.

"The past Claimer of Chaos."

THE Great Usurper spoke through the giants flesh, his authority commandeering the vessel with ease.

"You may have lost your Claim, but you are still grand. A vessel of possibilities that should not be discarded simply because one purpose has concluded."

The giants smile widened as THE Great Usurpers voice continued.

"I will forge you into something worthy again. Hmm!"

...!

The Chaos Giant turned and followed the others he had silently usurped!

Chapter 5055: Awakening! I

THE Secretive Eon appeared in a domain that existed between Observable and Unobservable.

The space measured only a mile wide in diameter, a pocket of stability carved into the boundary separating what could be perceived from what could not. Beyond its edges, swirling weavings of Unobservable wrapped around the domain in configurations that would have driven lesser beings mad merely from proximity. The darkness there moved with purpose, pressing against the domains boundaries without quite breaching them.

Within this small sanctuary, vibrant green grasses covered the ground in carpets that should not have been possible given the forces surrounding them. A simple white hut stood at the center, its construction humble and unremarkable, the kind of dwelling that suggested meditation rather than habitation. This place had been hidden for eons, known only to one existence in all of Observable Existence.

Until now.

Behind Eon, a sliver of a gateway remained open where she had entered. From it, THE Primordial Paradox stepped through, his obsidian titanic form immediately scanning the surroundings with attention that missed nothing. His paradoxical authority rippled around him as he observed the grasses, the hut, the swirling Unobservable beyond the boundaries.

"This place I have not been to."

His voice emerged with the weight of someone realizing they had been deceived.

"Just what more are you hiding?"

...!

THE Secretive Eon did not respond immediately.

She sat down upon the vibrant grasses with calm that seemed inappropriate. Her expression held resignation rather than fear, acceptance rather than anxiety. Whatever she was about to do, she had made peace with it long before this moment arrived.

Then she plunged her hand into her own chest.

Her fingers passed through flesh that parted without resistance, reaching into depths where her foundations resided. When she withdrew her hand, she held a key that blazed with golden light so pure it seemed to reject the surrounding Unobservable entirely. The key was ornate and ancient, its design suggesting purposes that predated most classifications Observable Existence currently employed.

Eon parted the hair behind her neck, exposing skin that had not seen light in eons.

Without looking at THE Primordial Paradox, she extended the key toward him.

"I wish I had never told you about me."

Her voice emerged flat and tired.

"I wanted to never return to that state. Even when I was being controlled by Unity, I did not reach out to it. I wanted to overcome it myself."

She paused.

"But I failed. Osmont scorched Unity out of me, and in turn, he has also loosened the seal. Since it will break regardless, I will consider this eons-long experiment to have been a failure. I thought I could make things happen without it, but whatever."

She thrust the key toward him more insistently.

"Take the key. I made it so that I could not fully unlock it myself."

...!

THE Primordial Paradox grasped the key with confusion visible across his obsidian features.

"What are you talking about? I reached out to you because of your Civilization. With it, my Paradox can undergo acceleration even-"

"I lied to you about my Civilization."

Her interruption was sharp and final.

"Just put the key on the back of my neck. Everything will become clearer after."

...!

THE Secretive Eon wore a hardened expression as she spoke these words.

A key. Something even THE Primordial Mycelia had never sensed during its occupation of her existence, something far above that fungal horrors stature to perceive. Naturally, a key meant something was locked. And right now, that something was Eon herself.

Turning the key would unlock her.

Doing so was an admission that she had failed, that her experiment in living as something lesser had concluded in defeat. What could she do? Existence was unfair. It had always been unfair. She had simply spent eons pretending otherwise.

Behind her, THE Primordial Paradox continued to frown as he brought the key toward her exposed neck.

"I may speak to you differently and change afterward."

Her voice held hesitation for the first time.

"Do not mind it. I will still be me. Just somewhat different."

...!

THE Primordial Paradox frowned even more deeply at her words. He shook his head at the strangeness of this situation, at the mysteries piling upon mysteries, at the sense that he was about to participate in something he did not understand.

Then he plunged the key into her neck.

The golden metal entered her flesh with blinding light that pressed against his perception. The key sank deeper than should have been possible, finding a lock that existed somewhere beyond physical form.

CLICK!

He turned the key.

And...

BOOM!

THE Primordial Paradox found his body flung across the domain before he could process what had occurred. He smashed against the boundaries where Observable met Unobservable, the collision sending shockwaves through his obsidian form. When he managed to orient himself and look back toward where Eon had been sitting...

He observed something magisterial!

All around the domain, golden misty light gathered with speed and density that defied comprehension.

The force of Observable itself was flooding into this small space, drawn by something that demanded its presence. Rivers of golden luminosity poured toward the figure of Eon from every direction, converging upon her form with intensity that painted the entire domain in hues of captured sunlight.

Her aura became something else entirely.

THE Primordial Paradox attempted to rise from where he had landed, pushing against the ground with strength that had conquered countless enemies across eons of conflict.

His body refused to comply. Something pressed down upon him with force that would not permit him to stand, as if all of surrounding existence had to remain low for what was waking up.

He could only watch from his position near the ground.

Golden rivers of Observable force continued flowing into Eon as she rose from the grasses without apparent effort. The power lifted her upward, rivers of golden light forming beneath her feet to create platforms of solidified authority. Her dark hair shone with brilliance that seemed to generate its own illumination rather than reflecting what surrounded her. Her eyes, when she opened them, radiated endless gold that pressed against THE Primordial Paradoxs perception with intensity.

The force she radiated horrified him.

It seemed to exceed the Singular Cognizance he had faced when fighting alongside Erwin. It surpassed what he had believed possible for any being at THE First Scale. It defied everything he understood about the hierarchy of power!

"What... is this?"

He had to ask the question even though speaking required effort against the pressure pinning him down.

Eon turned to look at him.

Her body had transformed. An unfathomable sense of beauty now permeated her existence, the kind that made observation feel like privilege rather than simple perception.

Radiant golden tattoos rolled from her neck down to her chest. Upon her wrists, golden bands shining with contained authority had formed, their presence suggesting royalty rather than ornamentation.

Her expression had changed as well.

Where before there had been coldness and calm, now there was coldness born of supremacy. Where before there had been calculation, now there was the calm of one who did not need to calculate because outcomes were predetermined in her favor.

Arrogance radiated from her bearing!

She replied to THE Primordial Paradox with a voice that sounded glorious and detached, as if she were addressing someone beneath her rather than an equal.

"What this is, is my whims coming to an end."

The golden rivers continued flowing into her as she spoke.

"I admit I do not have the power to do anything without what I was born with. You...will be rewarded for aiding me in my transition."

...!

Chapter 5056: Awakening! II

THE Primordial Paradox frowned at her tone, at the implicit dismissal contained within her words. He sought to rise again, gathering his Civilization of Paradox around him in preparation to force himself upward through whatever pressure held him down.

Eon simply waved her hand.

The pressure vanished, and he was able to stand.

His expression remained heavy as he observed her, still seeing boundless golden swirling misty light flowing into her form from every direction. The Observable force showed no signs of diminishing. If anything, it was accelerating, more rivers converging upon her with each passing moment.

"I really need you to explain now."

His voice emerged somber and demanding.

"Why do you feel even stronger than a Singular Cognizance at THE Second Scale when you should only be at THE First Scale?"

...!

THE Secretive Eon turned to look at him with calm and imperious bearing. She placed her hands upon her chest as if sensing her own existence, feeling the changes that the unlocking had wrought within her foundations.

"Because you and I are distinctly different."

Her words carried no apology.

"I was born made different. I tried to live like you and all others, and I failed. Because lifeforms like you, what I tried to be, do not have the capacity to influence Existence to a high enough level."

She paused, her golden eyes studying him with assessment that felt clinical.

"That part of myself has admitted this after falling prey to a fucking fungus and having to be saved by another. Which brings another problem because..."

Eon looked deeper into her existence as she spoke, her attention turning inward.

There, nestled within her foundations, she sensed something that made her frown. An irreversible and unbreakable bond with Quintessence Infiniforce existed within her, something that Osmont had placed in her eons ago in Ginnungagap. Her old self had not known about it. The connection had been subtle, hidden beneath layers of her diminished existence where her sealed perceptions could not reach.

It had entrenched itself into her existence so thoroughly that as she examined it now, she understood she could not expel it. The thing held Infinity within it, and Infinity was not something that could be removed through force alone.

Worse, this Quintessence Infiniforce was actually benefiting from her nature. She could sense her weavings, her authority, her Observable force flowing into the connection.

This would be a problem.

As she frowned at this discovery, THE Primordial Paradox maintained his heavy gaze upon her. He shook his head at answers that only generated more questions.

"What does that mean? What are you, really?"

His voice demanded truth rather than requesting it.

THE Secretive Eon turned to face him with calm that bordered on indifference.

"To understand what I am is to understand what you are."

Her golden eyes held no warmth.

"In Existence, all beings are not born equal. You are among THE Bounded Lifeforms. You and countless others. I am what is known as THE Gilded Lifeform. A different pedigree of lifeform entirely."

She let those words settle before continuing.

"My former self lied to you about my Civilization. My Civilization... is anything I wish among that which is Observable."

BOOM!

As she spoke these final words, she waved her hands to feel the heavy concentrated golden misty light of Observable continuing to flood into her form. The force responded to her gesture, swirling around her fingers as if eager to serve. She looked toward THE Primordial Paradox, who observed all of this with grim expression that could not hide his growing unease.

Eon shook her head at his obvious confusion.

"You required help with your Anchor? Sure. Here you go."

HUUM!

As she spoke, she tapped out with casual gesture that should not have been capable of accomplishing anything significant.

From the boundless power of Observable surrounding her, a blazing golden light began to form. It coalesced into configurations that THE Primordial Paradox recognized immediately, patterns that he had spent eons preparing to forge through careful affirmation and absolute self-knowledge.

A singularity of Paradox, perfect and complete, materialized from the force of Observable.

It entered into THE Primordial Paradox before he could react, flooding his foundations alongside an influx of Observable force that saturated every aspect of his existence. He had not called out any affirmations. He had not established his identity through the declarations that Civilizational Anchors required. He had not done anything except stand there and watch.

Yet an instant later...

BOOM!

A terrifying aura of power emanated from THE Primordial Paradox as shock overwhelmed his features.

A glorious Civilizational Anchor had formed within him without his participation. It felt just as powerful if not more powerful than what he would have forged himself through eons of careful preparation. The foundation of his transition to THE Proterozoic Scale now existed within his foundations, placed there by someone who had treated the process as casual generosity.

Before he could process what had just occurred, Eon looked at him with even greater calm.

"Have your Proterozoic Scale entry as well."

HUUM!

With such words, the tattoos adorning her body shone with brilliance that pressed against perception. Even more golden misty light flooded into THE Primordial Paradox, most of it flowing into his chest where his bones resided. The force pressed into his skeletal structure with intensity that would have destroyed any existence not prepared to receive it.

An aura of a Proterozoic Scale entity began radiating from his form.

His chest bones continued absorbing the golden misty light, transforming through processes that should have required years of careful cultivation. The Observable force was remaking him, elevating him, forcing advancement that he had not earned through any methodology he understood.

While all of this happened, he looked at Eon with incredulity that could not be contained.

"Hey. What the fuck is this?!"

His voice emerged with bewilderment that stripped away all composure.

THE Secretive Eon looked back at him with calm that bordered on boredom.

"A difference in Existence."

Her golden eyes held no sympathy for his confusion.

"I told you, not all beings are born equal. You and I are not born equal. You can understand it as a feat of Existential Engineering, but even that is not entirely true."

She waved her hand dismissively.

"No matter. Acclimate to your power and do not ask too much. I have to understand how the actions of my former self may have tainted me, because now I have a parasite of Infinity latched onto my existence."

She said this coolly before turning her attention inward, beginning to study the Quintessence Infiniforce that had entrenched itself within her foundations. The golden rivers continued flowing into her form, but her attention had already moved past THE Primordial Paradox and his questions.

He stood there stupefied, power he had not earned surging through foundations that barely understood what they had received.

What the fuck were THE Gilded?

Why was he and all others deemed THE Bounded?

Did that Designation apply to everyone he had ever known? To THE Creature? To Abaddon? To Erwin? To Osmont himself?

The questions multiplied within his awareness, each one more disturbing than the last.

THE Secretive Eon continued studying the Quintessence Infiniforce within her, paying him no further attention.

He was beneath her notice now as...perhaps he had always been.

Chapter 5057: For All To See! I

In THE Wastes, seas of multicolored brilliance swirled below while rivers surged above.

The figure of Beowulf floated within this transformed landscape, his massive hammer resting against one armored shoulder as he gazed out at the area where the illusory visage of THE Creature had been displayed. That image had faded now, but its implications remained. Horus was dead. THE Creature had claimed victory and displayed the proof for all of Observable Existence to witness!

The death was a heavy one, and it made Beowulf think about many things.

He had known Horus for eons. Now that ancient Primordial Architect was simply gone, his Eyes ripped from existence and held aloft like trophies by someone who had decided the time for tolerance had ended.

At such a time, something shifted behind him.

From the seas of multicolored Infinity at his back, singularities sparked and churned with activity that should not have been possible without his awareness. The waters of the Pluvial Epoch twisted into configurations that bent space, forming pathways where none had existed moments before. Authority pressed through those pathways with intention that announced arrival rather than requested permission.

Two figures emerged from the churning brilliance.

Noah stood at the forefront, his multicolored emperors robe flowing with currents of Infinity that wrapped around his form like loyal serpents. Alexander stood beside him, his green robes pristine and his Enneagram rotating upon his chest with steady determination. Both of them gazed forward with expressions cold and grand, as if they had come to this place specifically to challenge what awaited them.

The massive armored figure of Beowulf turned around to observe them in stupor.

Two First Scale entities had appeared before a Second Scale existence, and they bore themselves as if the difference in power meant nothing. Their postures held no deference. Their eyes held no fear. They floated before him with the bearing of challengers rather than prey, as if this confrontation was something they had chosen rather than something they would suffer!

Noah gazed at the massive visage of Beowulf as the Primordial Architect completed his turn.

When he looked at this being now, he did not feel that heavy sense of oppression that had pressed against him during their previous encounters. His foundations had changed. His capabilities had evolved. THE Hadean Organ of Civilization pulsed within his chest with authority that declared itself ready for whatever came next.

Beside him, Alexander wore an expression of extreme coldness.

He looked at Beowulf as if he was already dismantling the armored figure piece by piece, as if this confrontation was merely formality before the violence he had been anticipating since his torture concluded. His hands remained still at his sides, but the authority gathering around him suggested those hands would not remain idle for long.

Noah nodded to Beowulf.

"Big guy, did you miss us? I did not want to make you wait for too long, so I came to fulfill my oath."

...!

He had told this contemptible existence that he would return and pay things back manifold. That time was now here. The words emerged with confidence that pressed against the transformed landscape of THE Wastes!

Beowulf looked at them with expression that bordered on skepticism.

His armored head turned slightly, scanning the surrounding area as if searching for hidden allies or concealed traps. When he found nothing except the two beings floating before him, his twisted smile formed across features that had intimidated countless existences across eons of conflict.

"You...are arguably one of the most unique existences I have come across in a while."

His voice emerged with amusement that did not quite conceal his wariness.

Noahs response came immediately.

"And you are one of the more boring ones. Did you see your friend, Horus, and the humiliation of his corpse displayed for all to see across Existence?"

He spoke such words grandly, letting them hang in the air between them.

Beowulfs expression shifted into a frown that darkened his armored features. His hammer rose over his shoulders, the weapons presence alone causing the surroundings to begin trembling and shaking. Authority gathered around his form with intensity.

"Existence is vast and filled with wonders."

His voice emerged cold.

"Some of us will die. Some of us will triumph. With you coming here now, I will not allow you to slip away again. I will never have to experience the same fate as Horus."

His armored head tilted slightly.

"Once I grasp your weavings and secrets regarding Infinity..."

The sentence trailed off as his brutal smile returned.

"Hmmm."

Proterozoic Scale power spread outward from his form, sifting through the transformed landscape with authority that demanded submission from everything it touched. All churning rivers of multicolored brilliance around them ceased their movement. The flowing seas below became still. For the surrounding light years, everything that had been in motion simply stopped.

Even the rain falling from above halted in place, droplets of the Pluvial Epoch suspended in air that no longer permitted their descent.

Noah gave a light nod at this display of power.

"Seeing the actions of THE Creature reminded me that when it comes to truly breaking down ones enemies and letting others know how to act, seeing is better than believing."

His eyes shone with purpose.

"So..."

He raised his hand and clenched it.

The multicolored seas of Infinity shook in response to his gesture. Around them, massive disturbances churned through the transformed waters as something vast began to rise from the depths. Three illusory screens emerged from the brilliance, each one a single light year in diameter, their surfaces displaying images that captured everything occurring in this space.

The screens showed the figure of Beowulf and their figures with clarity that missed no detail.

"My weavings of Infinity are spread all across Observable Existence."

Noahs voice carried across the light years his screens encompassed.

"Just like THE Creature was able to illuminate the fate of Horus, I will go a step further to illuminate and illustrate. I will give all of Observable Existence the chance to see the fates of those poor enough to come after me."

The illusory screens shone with brilliance that exceeded their already massive presence.

What they displayed began to permeate across Observable Existence.

Across THE Wastes, screens rose from seas and rivers of transformed brilliance. In Primordial Realms scattered throughout existence, similar displays emerged from wherever Infinity had touched. Within remaining shelters of THE Loom, screens materialized before beings who had thought themselves hidden and protected!

In Prima Indifferentia, illusory images pressed through barriers that should have been impenetrable! The Wandering Territories! The Lands of The Dead!

In all places where Infinity sensed Absolutes or any glimmers of Second Scale Existences, these illusory screens began to rise.

They streamed everything occurring at this moment.

Noah looked up as the illusory screens zoomed upon his face, Alexander visible behind him.

Multicolored Infinities wrapped around his body in rivers of endless authority. His multicolored emperors robe shone gloriously!

While looking into the screen, he spoke words meant for all of Observable Existence.

"Let this be a lesson and warning to all."

HUUM!

He said for this to be a warning, but he knew many would not take it like so. He knew many would take it as a challenge, which would in turn...invite Adversity. And that...was also another goal of his!

Beowulf observed this display as his gaze became unfathomably cold.

His massive body was reflected on the screens surrounding them, his armored form towering over Noah and Alexander like a giant observing ants!

His pride as an existence so much grander than them buzzed with indignation at this moment, at being made a spectacle for beings across Observable Existence to witness!

"I will not stop at dissecting your existence. I will-"

At such a time, Noahs words interrupted him.

"Hold on."

...!

Because at this moment, Noah began to feel something horrific and grand inside his existence.

A flood of the power of Observable surged from within him in an unfathomable manner, its concentration far exceeding anything he had handled before. Golden misty light erupted from his foundations with intensity that should have torn him apart. The force was vast and overwhelming, a sea of Observable power pouring through connections he had not consciously activated!

It felt surreal and utterly overwhelming.

There was so much that his existence was almost initially overwhelmed by the sheer volume of what was flooding through him. His foundations trembled under the pressure, his cells burning with golden light that pressed outward from within. Then THE Hadean Organ of Civilization began to spin right after, collecting the terrifying misty golden seas of Observable force with efficiency that prevented catastrophic overflow.

Every cell and atom within his body literally began to burn with golden light of Observable!

His existence worked rapidly to process what was occurring. Infinite Undifferentiated Fate searched for the connection to understand where this flood originated, but he could not find anything apart from the connection with THE Primordial Paradox.

When he dug deeper toward the source of these terrifying waves of Observable force, he felt as if he was being blocked by barriers that resisted his perception.

He proceeded to use the overflowing power of Observable itself to finally affirm the truth.

Particles of his Quintessence Infiniforce were acting as pathways, pulling from a source. The connection led to...Eon. THE Secretive Eon!

What...

"Are you okay?"

Beside him, Alexander asked the question as Noah appeared to have frozen in place, his eyes burning with golden light while his expression shifted through confusion and calculation.

As Noah was in the middle of ascertaining all this, Beowulf became cold and apathetic.

The Primordial Architect raised his hammer. His armored features showed no amusement now, no fucking tolerance for whatever his opponents were experiencing!

He had been interrupted, insulted, and made into a spectacle for all of Observable Existence to witness.

"No playing around this time."

His voice emerged with frost that spread across the suspended droplets around them.

"I will collapse you and look at the pieces after. Let me show you how vast the gulf is between THE Second Scale and THE First Scale."

HUUM!

As he said this, he swung his hammer.

Noahs eyes could see the backbone and makeup of that weapon as it descended toward him and Alexander. Within the hammers construction, a single shining crimson obsidian bone blazed with light that pressed against perception.

A Proterozoic Bone, fully activated, channeling the full might of a Second Scale existence through an instrument designed specifically for destruction.

The hammer thundered down toward them!

Time seemed to slow as Noah processed what was occurring. The flood of Observable force continued burning through his foundations. The hammer continued its descent.

Alexander stood beside him, ready to fight but lacking the capability to stop what was coming. The illusory screens broadcast everything to Observable Existence, capturing the moment when THE Youngest would be crushed by power he should not have challenged!

Noah put his hand on his chest.

His fingers pressed through his emperors robe, reaching toward the Organ of Civilization that spun with fury within him. From that Organ, he pulled forth a weapon that should not have existed at THE First Scale.

THE Hadean Spear of Civilization emerged from his sternum.

The multicolored crystalline Kontos spear materialized into his grip as the hammer continued its descent!

Around his body, the vibrant lights of Observable and Unobservable began swirling with intensity that exceeded anything he had previously channeled. Golden mist and clear smoke wound around his form, both forces converging upon the tip of his spear with concentration that made the air itself tremble.

The tip of the spear rose to meet the giant hammer!

And...

CRACK!

The impact was shocking and forceful and blinding!

A horrid sound echoed across existence as Proterozoic Bone met Civilizational Armament, as THE Second Scale collided with something that should not have been possible at THE First Scale.

Light erupted from the point of contact with brilliance that painted the suspended droplets of rain with hues existence rarely witnessed.

Noah remained floating exactly where he was.

He did not move. He did not budge. He did not shift a single inch from the position he had occupied before the hammers descent.

Instead, the massive hammer of Beowulf was knocked backward and upward.

...!

Oh!

The weapon that had crushed an unknown number of existences across eons of conflict recoiled from the collision, its Proterozoic Bone ringing with frequencies!

Beowulfs armored arms absorbed the recoil, his massive form pushed back by a force that should not have come from a First Scale being.

Stupor and astonishment followed.

Noah stood there in the aftermath, his spear held at angle.

The light of Quintessence Infiniforce blazed around him in rivers of multicolored brilliance. Infinity wrapped around his form, and Unobservable and Observable forces swirled around his weapon in clear and golden rivers that pressed against everything they touched.

He held that spear!

THAT Spear!

THE Hadean Spear of Civilization!

Chapter 5060: What Are You? II

He could never be like her no matter what he did, she said.

Only the absolute certainty that regardless of what Existence had engineered him to be, regardless of what Designations he was supposed to remain within, regardless of what they would do to him for his transgressions, he would become something that made their classifications seem small.

Her expression shifted into something that resembled regret.

"So I sealed myself. I locked away what I was and chose to live as THE Bounded, to experience Adversity as they experienced it, to struggle as they struggled, to feel the weight of limitations I had never known before."

I even looked at the Adversity THE Creature and Erwin engineered and promised myself I would strip them of their distinctions as Keys of Civilizations of our Observable Existence and take them myself or give them to others."
