But as of this moment, feeling his existence shatter and rebuild stronger with every impact, watching his bones transform toward Hadean classification through force that should have killed him, he was a big fan of adversity.

Bring more of it on!

Bring someone else like Grimvault! Bring another Calymmian Proterozoic Scale being if possible! Bring someone at even higher tiers, at classifications that most couldnt imagine!

Bring it all!

"OOOH!"

Every atom within him seethed with immensity and roared with voices that transcended physical sound. Golden seas erupted from his existence and shone across the destroyed battlefield, Observable force radiating outward in waves that painted reality itself in hues of transformation and glory.

Grimvault observed this display with those pale fires burning brighter in his empty eye sockets.

His smile hadnt faded.

If anything, it had grown wider.

Chapter 5092: Evolution II

A lot of Existences mention the glory before battle and silence after it. The glory belongs to those who survive long enough to claim it. The silence belongs to those who learned the truth.

The truth that darkness does not care about strength or conviction or righteousness. It comes for all equally, and when it arrives, every being discovers the same terrible knowledge: they were never prepared for the cold or for the absence.

Not for the regret that blooms in the space where hope used to reside. The casualties of war are the final thoughts of beings who finally understood they should have chosen differently, and understood it exactly one moment too late.

-Reflections on War.

---

Naldine observed the impossible.

Her fingers rested on the strings of her Vihuela as she watched Noah and Ozymandias meet Grimvaults second strike head-on, golden light exploding outward from the impact. She could perceive what was happening to his existence even from this distance, could sense the cycles of destruction and rebirth cascading through his foundations with each blow the Calymmian entity delivered.

He was growing stronger explosively with every impact that should have killed him!

And he...hadnt even used the Pulse he theorized yet.

What manner of existence was he?

Shed lived for eons among Primordial Architects, had witnessed beings at classifications that most couldnt imagine, had herself achieved advancement that placed her among the distinguished of THE Wyld. But shed never seen anything like what he was doing right now...

"THE WHORISH NALDINE!"

BOOM!

The roar shattered her contemplation.

Vahrkosis surged toward her with those forty-seven arms raised, each one wielding distinct pieces of an Axiom that blazed with entropic authority. His serpentine coils undulated through the air with speed that belied his massive form, and his voice emerged with fury.

"Focus on our grand battle! Do you think yourself so far above me that you can divide your attention? I am THE Primordial Dirge! I have consumed civilizations while you were still learning to pluck strings!"

His face, that shifting mass of features at the apex of his coils, settled into configuration of rage that seemed almost personal.

"Or perhaps you wish to watch that little bundle of Infinity die? Perhaps youve grown attached during whatever time you spent together? THE WHORISH NALDINE, pining after something that should not exist!"

...!

Those words landed heavily.

Naldines singularity-dotted eyes turned from Noahs battle with coldness that could have frozen stars. Her fingers, which had been resting gently on her Vihuelas strings, pressed down with precision. Her expression, which had held analytical interest moments before, became something that made even Vahrkosis pause his charge despite his rage.

She plucked a single string.

HUUM!

The note that emerged was authority given audible form, a frequency that pressed against existence itself with command. The note washed over Vahrkosis and his serpentine coils froze mid-undulation, those forty-seven arms suspended in positions!

He was held through something he couldnt perceive or resist!

His form remained locked in place as Naldine rose from her position, her Vihuelas strings still resonating with frequencies that kept him immobilized while she prepared what came next.

"You hear words others have spoken and choose to use them as well? You call me whorish," she said, her voice emerging cold and measured despite the fury burning beneath her expression. "You, who have consumed and destroyed and violated across eons of existence, dare to speak of me with such words?"

Her left hand, the one that had been her arm before she transformed it into her instrument, began to move.

Her fingers moved through the air as if writing upon reality itself, tracing symbols that existed in no language most beings could perceive. Each motion left trails of blue gold light that hung suspended, configurations that suggested letters being formed.

Her index finger drew a vertical line downward. Her middle finger curved around it in spiral that suggested revision. Her ring finger slashed horizontally through what had been written, not erasing but transforming. Her smallest finger added new strokes that changed the meaning of the entire inscription.

She was writing.

She was rewriting!

And when the somatic component completed, her voice emerged with verbal utterance that pressed against the foundations of reality itself.

"Cambrian Scribe, First of Words."

The light around her fingers blazed brighter.

"I speak the Thread. I rewrite the Thread."

The inscribed symbols began to pulse with authority that exceeded what even Proterozoic Scale entities could typically produce.

"What was shall mean another. What ended shall end differently."

Her singularity-dotted eyes locked onto Vahrkosiss frozen form with intensity that seemed to perceive not just what he was, but what he had been and what he could become.

"THE CAMBRIAN WORD."

BOOM!

The Pulse manifested.

It was not fire like THE Silurian Light. It was not erasure or unwinding or destruction of causality. It was transformation of meaning itself, the fundamental restructuring of what consequences attached to what actions. Blue gold light erupted from Naldines inscribed symbols and washed over Vahrkosis with force that passed through his defenses as if they didnt exist.

Because they didnt exist against this.

Pulses operated on levels that normal authority couldnt touch. They drew power from Causes themselves, from the originating forces that had formed Observable Existences, and no amount of Proterozoic Bones or Organs could provide resistance against something so fundamental.

Vahrkosis felt it immediately.

His serpentine coils began to unravel conceptually, the very meaning of his existence being rewritten by authority that exceeded his capacity to resist. The forty-seven arms that had wielded pieces of an Axiom began dissolving not into nothing but into something else, their purpose being changed from violence to dissolution, their function being rewritten from attack to self-destruction.

"What... what is this?"

His voice emerged with horror that pressed against the destroyed battlefield.

"Stop...stop!!!"

He could feel it. Every action he had ever taken was being rewritten not in occurrence but in consequence. The civilizations he had consumed were still consumed, but the strength he had gained from them was being redirected, transformed, changed from fuel for his power into fuel for his dissolution. The Proterozoic Bones he had forged were still forged, but their purpose was being rewritten from enhancement to entropy.

"You do not know a Pulse," Naldine said, her voice cold as she watched him unravel. "You have existed for eons, have consumed countless beings, have achieved classification that most cannot imagine. And yet you never touched the depths required to perceive what Pulses are, never achieved access sufficient to find where they reside."

Her fingers plucked another string, and the rewriting accelerated.

"THE Whorish Naldine. Those were your words."

Vahrkosiss coils were dissolving now, that serpentine mass collapsing into transformation. He was becoming something other than what he had been, his existence being rewritten!

"The consequence of those words," Naldine continued, "has been rewritten. You spoke them intending to diminish me, to anger me, to distract me from your attack. But now those words mean something else. Now they mean that you chose to provoke someone who possesses THE Cambrian Word."

"Please..."

The word emerged from features that were losing coherence, from a face that was being rewritten into something that could no longer produce speech.

"I do not hear pleas," Naldine said. "I hear only the sound of causality being corrected."

She watched as THE Primordial Dirge, that Rhyacian Tier Proterozoic Scale entity, unraveled completely. His forty-seven arms had become nothing. His serpentine coils had dissolved into authority that dispersed across the destroyed battlefield. His Proterozoic Bones and Organ remained, falling through the air where his form had once occupied space, multicolored brilliance declaring their nature even as their owner ceased to exist in any meaningful sense.

Vahrkosis was gone.

Not erased like THE Silurian Light would have accomplished, not removed from causality entirely. He still existed in memory, still existed in consequence, still existed in the damage he had caused across his long existence. But his continuation had been rewritten. His future had been transformed into dissolution. His existence had been edited to end at this exact moment through words that rewrote what his choices meant.

Naldine lowered her Vihuela.

And the battlefield...became eerily silent as many turned to her!

Chapter 5093: Evolution III

The battlefield fell silent.

THE Primordial Paradox observed Vahrkosiss dissolution with appreciation. The serpentine mass that had been THE Primordial Dirge was simply gone, unraveled by authority that Pulses provided and normal Proterozoic classification couldnt resist.

Forty-seven arms had become nothing. Coils that had undulated with entropic menace now existed only as memory and scattered Proterozoic material falling through empty air that Naldine collected!

Naldine Manthon had just eliminated a Rhyacian Tier entity in seconds.

Even Grimvault paused his assault on Noah to gaze toward where his companion had stood. Those pale fires burning in his wolf skull helm flickered with cold fury that pressed against the destroyed battlefield, and for an instant, that devastating Axiom stopped swinging.

THE Primordial Paradox smiled.

This was his moment.

He wasnt the most powerful entity present. He knew that with certainty!

Grimvault exceeded him tremendously. Even Sammarthiel, the being he currently faced, possessed more Proterozoic Bones and Organs than he did. In a direct confrontation of power against power, he would lose. He would fall. He would become another casualty of a battle.

But THE Primordial Paradox had never believed in direct confrontation.

Paradox was his Civilization. Contradiction was his authority. And the greatest contradiction of combat was this: the moment your enemy stopped paying attention was the moment they had already lost, even if victory still appeared to be within their grasp.

Sammarthiels beautiful and terrible features were turned toward where Vahrkosis had dissolved. Those wings of burning and frozen swords had ceased their constant motion, thousands of blades suspended in configurations of shock rather than readiness. His attention was divided between the horror of watching an ally unravel and the fury of recognizing that Naldine possessed capabilities none of them had anticipated.

That division was everything.

THE Primordial Paradox moved without sound.

His obsidian titanic form surged forward with speed that contradicted his massive size, Rhyacian Proterozoic power flooding through foundations that had been enhanced by something most beings couldnt comprehend. The Bounded Countable Infinity hed obtained from Osmont blazed within his existence with blue light that wove through his authority!

He wasnt merely Paradox anymore.

He was Paradox touched by Infinity. He was contradiction given endless recursion. He was the impossible made more impossible through forces that his Civilization had integrated rather than rejected.

His Proterozoic chest bone began to shine.

The light that emerged was something else entirely, illumination that seemed to exist and not exist simultaneously, brightness that was also darkness, visibility that was also concealment. The bone pulsed with authority that declared its paradoxical nature to anything capable of perceiving such depths.

Sammarthiel sensed the attack one instant too late.

The Paradox Bearer turned from his observation of Vahrkosiss fate, those twin blades of flame and frost rising in defensive configuration as he recognized that THE Primordial Paradox had moved. But recognition wasnt prevention. Awareness wasnt escape!

He could see the paradoxical light surging toward him and still be unable to avoid what that light represented.

"You dare-...!"

The words cut off as...Schrodingers Tomb enveloped him.

Its capabilities were actually rather simple.

The Target is enclosed in state of fundamental uncertainty. Until observation occurs or the target breaks free through sufficient force, they exist in superposition of alive and dead simultaneously. The longer they remain in this state, the more their existence becomes entangled with the paradox itself. Extended exposure causes progressive dissolution of certainty regarding their own continuation!

It wasnt a cage in the physical sense. There were no bars, no walls, no boundaries that could be perceived through normal observation. Instead, Sammarthiel simply became uncertain. His form flickered between presence and absence, between continuation and cessation, between the alive state and the dead state without settling on either.

He was trapped in the space between outcomes.

And the longer he remained there, the more that space would consume what he understood himself to be.

THE Primordial Paradox observed his work with satisfaction. Sammarthiel struggled within the Tomb, those six wings of swords attempting to cut through uncertainty itself, but you couldnt cut what didnt exist in definable form. You couldnt burn or freeze or destroy a state of being that was simultaneously every state and no state at all.

He shouldve never allowed this cage to form as he was powerful enough to evade it!

But he...was distracted.

And as of this moment...

Two Rhyacian Tier Proterozoic Scale entities were both out of commission.

THE Primordial Paradox floated grandly above the destroyed battlefield, his obsidian form radiating authority that declared his classification to all who could perceive it. He didnt possess Pulses. He didnt channel powers derived from Causes that formed Observable Existences. But he possessed something that Pulses couldnt replicate and overwhelming force couldnt overcome.

He possessed understanding of contradiction itself.

Victory and defeat were merely states that observers assigned to outcomes after those outcomes had been determined. But what happened when determination itself became uncertain? What happened when the very concept of winning or losing became entangled with paradox that refused to resolve into either?

This battle was neither won nor lost.

He thought about what Paradox meant at its deepest levels.

Most beings understood contradiction as opposition. Light against dark. Life against death. Victory against defeat. They saw paradox as tension between states that couldnt coexist, as problems requiring resolution rather than conditions to be embraced.

THE Primordial Paradox knew better.

Contradiction... was completion. Light didnt fight darkness as it moreso it defined it. Life didnt battle death...it required it. And victory didnt triumph over defeat; it existed only because defeat was possible.

This battle existed in that space between.

Not won and not lost, but simply continuing in uncertainty that favored those who understood uncertainty better than their enemies.

He turned his gaze toward Grimvault, toward that wolf skull helm with its burning pale fires.

What...would the ancient Primordial Architect do now?

---

Grimvaults eyes flashed cold.

Noah observed the shift in that wolf skull helms pale fires, watched the amusement drain away and something far more dangerous take its place. The Calymmian Tier Primordial Architect had been playing before.

But Vahrkosis was gone now, unraveled by Naldines Pulse. Sammarthiel was trapped in paradoxical uncertainty, flickering between alive and dead without resolution.

Grimvault was alone.

And alone, he stopped playing!

His left hand rose with speed that should have been impossible for something so massive. His palm faced outward, fingers spread wide as if preparing to grasp something that existed beyond physical perception. The gesture held stillness that seemed almost reverent, a warrior preparing to unleash a weapon that had been waiting since before Observable Existence learned to observe.

Then his fingers began to move.

The first motion was a curling inward, each finger bending in sequence from smallest to largest as if he were grasping threads of reality itself. His hand drew backward in a pulling motion, those invisible threads gathering in his palm like strands of causality being unraveled from the weaving that held them in place.

...!

Noahs gaze became heavy!

His palm rotated slowly, drawing a circle in the air that suggested reversal, regression, the unwinding of time flowing backward against its natural current. The motion was ancient, gestures that seemed to have existed before gestures were possible!

Noah could see it!

He could see the threads!

That was the terrifying part. He could actually see what Grimvault was grasping, could perceive the strands of causality being gathered in that armored palm, could witness the fundamental forces being prepared for deployment. His enhanced Civilizational Access showed him exactly what was coming.

Grimvaults fingers snapped outward in a flicking motion, releasing whatever he had gathered while simultaneously reaching toward something distant. Then his hand closed into a fist, authority condensing!

His fist opened.

His fingers spread as fire would bloom from kindling, and his voice emerged with words that pressed against existence itself.

"Silurian Ember, First of Flames."

The air began to burn with light that shouldnt have existed.

"I grasp the Thread. I burn the Thread."

Colors that had no names blazed outward from his spreading fingers!

"What was shall be unwritten, what stood shall stand no more."

The light intensified until looking at it became difficult even for beings at Proterozoic classification.

"THE SILURIAN LIGHT."

BOOM!

The Pulse emerged in its full grandeur.

It wasnt merely fire or light. It was something that existed at the intersection of both while transcending either, a manifestation of THE Silurian Cause itself reduced to pale imitation that remained devastating despite its diminished state!

The brilliance roared outward from Grimvaults extended hand like an emerging Cause, like the birth of an Observable Existence compressed into weapon form as it was directed towards...Naldine and THE Primordial Paradox!

Noahs gaze became stern and somber.

This wasnt playful anymore!

Grimvault had targeted both Naldine and THE Primordial Paradox with authority that would erase their causality entirely, would unwrite their existence until not even memory remained. The light surged toward them in twin streams of impossible brilliance, each one carrying force sufficient to unmake beings who had survived eons of existence.

Naldines singularity-dotted eyes widened as she sensed death approaching. Her fingers moved toward her Vihuelas strings, but THE Cambrian Word required time she didnt have. The rewriting Pulse couldnt intercept an erasing Pulse when the erasing Pulse had already been released!

THE Primordial Paradoxs obsidian form flickered with paradoxical light as he attempted to apply contradiction to what was coming. But THE Silurian Light didnt care about paradox. It didnt care about alive or dead states. It simply erased, and erasure transcended the philosophical frameworks that Paradox operated within!

Both of them roared with defiance that couldnt change what was approaching!

And then...

And then Noah appeared in front of Naldine.

And Ozymandias appeared in front of THE Primordial Paradox.

Both bodies moved simultaneously!

Noah positioned himself directly in the path of the Silurian stream targeting Naldine while Ozymandias blocked the stream targeting THE Primordial Paradox.

His expression was unfathomably calm.

Time seemed to slow as he looked at the blinding light of THE Silurian Light approaching his existence. The brilliance filled his perception with colors that shouldnt have been capable of existing simultaneously!

It was...beautiful, and it was truly terrifying. It was..exactly what hed been searching for.

He wasnt one for sacrifices.

That had never been his nature. He didnt throw himself in front of attacks to protect others out of noble impulse or heroic instinct. He wasnt sacrificing himself right now, wasnt offering his existence to preserve theirs. That kind of thinking belonged to beings who didnt understand what he understood about himself.

He wanted to see.

He wanted to feel what a Pulse was all about.

That...was how confident he was about his own existence.

If it was a terrifying adversity even more than the swing of Grimvaults weapon, all the better. If it carried force sufficient to trigger THE Crucible of Observable Rebirth at accelerations that exceeded what THE Octogenary Echo had provided, even better still.

But more than wanting to survive it, he wanted to know if he could take it.

In life, you had to do dangerous things if you wanted things to change drastically. You had to take bigger risks if you wanted bigger rewards. You couldnt grow into something unprecedented by following safe paths that others had already mapped. You had to step into the unknown and let the unknown do its worst.

And he...wanted things to change drastically.

The Hadean Bones throughout his body blazed brighter as THE Silurian Light approached. Observable force surged through his existence in concentrations that exceeded anything hed channeled before. Quintessence Infiniforce flooded outward from his foundations in waves of multicolored brilliance that met the approaching erasure like a tide meeting a shore.

Could he take it?

He was about to find out.

"FOOL!"

Grimvaults roar echoed across the destroyed battlefield with genuine alarm. The Calymmian Tier Primordial Architect actually stepped forward as if he could recall what he had already released.

"I never intended to use THE Silurian Light on you! There are too many unknowns if you are erased!"

...!

But it was too late for intentions.

The streams of impossible brilliance had already crossed the distance.

The light touched both of Noahs bodies simultaneously.

And existence...became unfathomably silent!

Chapter 5094: What Gives You The Right?! I

<Exerpt from an Echoes of THE First Cause>

"The adversity that breaks all others shall forge him. The hardship that ends all paths shall begin his. The Scales demand what the Scales demand, and he shall pay in currencies that have not yet been minted.

Three times shall he face the mirror of undoing. Three times shall he choose between becoming and unbecoming. Three times shall the answer be the same, and three times shall the answer be different.

In the end, which is also the beginning, the Infinite shall stand before the Undefined. And only one shall remain to tell the tale that no one shall hear.

This is an Echo of First Cause.

This is what shall come to pass, for it has already passed, and it shall pass again.

The wheel turns. The river flows. The question echoes.

He shall be the answer, or he shall be nothing.

Or he shall be the question that ends all answers."

---

There exists a term for those who find pleasure in pain.

Algophilist!

From the word algos, meaning pain, and philos, meaning lover. One who loves suffering. One who seeks agony not as means to an end but as the end itself. The sensation of hurt becomes indistinguishable from the sensation of joy, and they pursue both with equal fervor because to them, both are the same.

Noah Osmont...was not an algophilist!

---

Silence.

All of existence turned silent as for the first time, Noah became the target of a Pulse of The Scales. THE Silurian Light touched him, and in that instant, he understood what Alexander had felt when Beowulf tortured him across millions of subjective years. Every Existential Nociceptor within his existence activated simultaneously, every pain receptor screaming with immensity and entered territories that most beings couldnt survive experiencing.

Pain.

Real pain. Not the cycles of destruction and rebirth that Grimvaults weapon had provided. Not the shattering and reforming that THE Crucible of Observable Rebirth had transformed into fuel for advancement. This was something else entirely, agony that existed at the level of causality itself, suffering that came from having your very existence told it should never have been.

And Noah defiantly felt all of it.

He didnt defend or retreat. He didnt channel Infinity or Observable force to resist what was happening. He wanted to feel this. He wanted to understand what a Pulse truly was, what it meant to have something derived from a Cause deployed against your existence. So he opened himself to the pain and focused through it with clarity that his previous transformations had provided.

His existence bellowed toward the Pulse in defiance.

What are you? What do you stand for?

HUUM!

The answer came in sensation. He felt himself being stared down by an unfathomable imperious gaze of endless potential, a presence so vast that his perception couldnt find its edges. This was a Cause.

THE Silurian Cause itself, the First Ember that had ignited Observable Existences into being across the vastness of reality. The Pulse he faced was drawing power from that originating force, and when an entity was targeted by such a thing, they felt the immensity behind it.

The immensity of THE Silurian Cause.

It seemed that one could feel it and experience a semblance of it only when targeted for complete erasure. In that moment of tremendous pain, Noah understood what THE Silurian Cause actually was.

It was fire before fire existed. It was ignition before anything could burn. It was the spark! It had birthed Observable Existences, had provided the template for reality, had established the foundations upon which all current existence stood.

And it wanted him gone.

|Understanding Achieved.|

|You have experienced direct contact with THE Silurian Cause through exposure to THE Silurian Light.|

|This Cause represents: Primordial ignition. The authority to declare existence into being, and therefore, the authority to declare existence into unbeing.|

|Knowledge of this Cause has been seared into your foundations. You now possess comprehension of THE Silurian Cause at foundational level.|

|This comprehension may enable future derivations if sufficient resonance is established.|

And after he experienced this Cause, after that moment of understanding bloomed through his awareness, he began to feel what came next.

Every atom within his existence screamed.

They were set aflame by that terrifying fiery light, burned by authority that had ignited Observable Existences and could therefore extinguish anything within them. The light pressed against every particle of what he was with a declaration that expected obedience.

Be erased.

Disappear.

Your existence has never been and will never be.

BEGONE!

HUUM!

His cells screamed. His existence screamed. And all of this was happening in the span of an instant, destruction cascading through his foundations at speeds that objective time couldnt properly measure. He could feel his causality beginning to unravel, could sense the threads connecting his past to his present to his future being grasped by that fiery authority and pulled apart.

With Noah at the center, cracks bloomed in four directions!

BOOM!

The fractures spread outward from his existence like lightning frozen in glass, extending toward horizons that didnt exist in normal space. His unraveling was unraveling existence itself, Infinity responding to the erasure of its bearer by threatening to take everything else with it. The cracks stretched infinitely in four different directions, north and south and east and west, reality itself protesting what was being done to someone so thoroughly entangled with its foundations.

Grimvault went pale beneath that wolf skull helm.

Those pale fires in his empty eye sockets flickered! The ancient Primordial Architect shook his head at this scene, recognizing that collapsing every causality of the Infinity-bearer could have untold consequences that extended far beyond this battlefield!

Noahs existence was roaring out in response to the unfathomable pain and unwinding of his very causality. Every part of what he was said no.

A declaration of absolute refusal that pressed back against the Pulse with authority that came from somewhere deeper than his current classification could explain.

His Quintessence Infiniforce said no.

His Observable Force said no.

His connection to Infinity said no.

THE First Tongue said no.

THE Infiniverse said no.

And then Noah heard something else. A voice that didnt belong to any system or Civilization or cosmic force. A voice he recognized from years of hearing it call him to dinner, wake him for school, comfort him through nightmares that childhood had provided.

His mother.

"How dare you?!"

BOOM!

Chapter 5095: What Gives You The Right?! II

Amelia Osmont, THE Originator of THE Infinite Cause, raged from wherever she existed within THE Infiniverse. Her voice crashed through Noahs awareness with fury, the primal anger of a mother watching something try to erase her child. How dare they try to unmake what she had carried for nine months? How dare they try to unwrite what she had raised through sleepless nights and double shifts and years of sacrifice?!

How dare they?!

At such a moment, Noahs eyes released blinding beams of light.

He dared to ask the Pulse of The Scales, the Pulse backed by THE Silurian Cause, a question that no one had ever asked while being targeted for erasure. His voice emerged not as sound but as existence itself bellowing toward the force that was trying to unmake him.

"What gives you the right?!"

WAA!

What gave this Cause the authority to unravel his causality? His very being? Was this Cause grander than his Cause? Was THE Silurian Cause so absolutely superior to THE Infinite Cause that it could simply declare him nonexistent and have that declaration stick?

His body surrounded itself in radiant magma-like light as THE Silurian Light continued its assault, flames that should have been erasing him instead illuminating his defiance for all to witness. He raised both arms, his primary body and Ozymandias moving in perfect synchrony despite the agony they both experienced.

And he roared with all of his existence.

Words emerged that nobody but himself and the force of THE Silurian Cause would hear, a challenge issued not to Grimvault but to the Cause behind Grimvaults Pulse.

"What makes your Cause grander?!"

His voice tore through the flames surrounding him.

"THE Infinite Cause gave its emergence to me! Can you say with Absolute Certainty that THE Silurian Cause is grander than THE Infinite Cause?!"

The magma-light flickered.

"That of the endless threads and weavings of Causality, of past, present, and future, THE Infinite Cause is not grander than THE Silurian Cause?!"

HUUM!

His existence shone with blinding blue gold light that pushed back against the flames trying to erase him. Instead of fighting against the Pulse itself, he pitted the force behind it against his own Cause. Not power against power. Not authority against authority. But certainty against certainty.

Could THE Silurian Cause say with absolute conviction that it would always be grander than THE Infinite Cause? Because Noahs growth wasnt done. His trajectory wasnt complete. THE Infinite Cause had already produced a Seed of Observable Existence, had already demonstrated potential that rivaled what THE Silurian Cause itself represented.

Did it have absolute certainty?!

Could it prove, beyond any reasonable possible doubt, that THE Infinite Cause would never surpass it across the endless spans of future existence?!

HUUM!

A heavy silence came.

This silence was uncertainty. And if there was uncertainty, even the slightest doubt about the absolute superiority of one Cause over another, then THE Silurian Light couldnt complete its erasure. It couldnt unravel causality that might one day prove grander than its own origin. It couldnt destroy potential that remained undefined.

"OOOH!"

Noah roared out with fervor as his voice permeated across existence, the sound of someone who had just challenged a Cause itself and found that Cause unable to answer with absolute conviction.

|Critical Interaction Resolved.|

|THE Silurian Cause behind THE Silurian Light cannot definitively and absolutely prove its sovereignty over THE Infinite Cause.|

|THE Infinite Cause has demonstrated trajectory of growth that makes future superiority possible, if not probable. Absolute certainty of permanent superiority cannot be established when one Cause continues to evolve while the other has already achieved its zenith.|

|Result: THE Silurian Cause cannot unravel THE Infinite Cause.|

|You have gained immunity from any unraveling force of causality derived from THE Silurian Cause and any Pulses of The Scales derived from it.|

|However.|

|THE Silurian Cause is and has been grander than THE Infinite Cause in current measurement. While you are immune to complete unraveling, the effects of THE Silurian Light are still expressed with terrifying immensity capable of destroying every particle of your existence.|

|This destruction triggers THE Crucible of Observable Rebirth.|

|This light is more than sufficient to continue undergoing endless cycles of destruction and reformation until your Hadean Organs and Bones complete their transformation.|

|Until your glorious evolution attains something new.|

|Persevere.|

...!

Noah saw all these prompts as his body continued blazing with magma-like light. He felt the flames of THE Silurian Light scorch every cell and atom of his existence in an instant, fire that couldnt erase but could still destroy. And in that same instant, boundless Quintessence Infiniforce and Observable Force and Infinity surged into the destruction, regenerating everything that had been burned before the next wave of flames arrived.

A nanosecond later, the same thing happened again.

And again.

And again.

Visually, it seemed like the magma-like light of THE Silurian Light was simply burning him, flames wrapping around his form in configurations of destruction that should have been lethal. But a blast of blue gold brilliance flashed every nanosecond, explosions of reformation cascading outward from his existence with rhythm that only those who understood what was happening could perceive. Each flash signified a cycle of destruction and rebirth. Each burst of brilliance meant brand new cells across Noahs body, grander than what had existed a nanosecond before.

Ozymandias underwent the same transformation.

His titanic form blazed with identical magma-light, flames of THE Silurian Light scorching every particle of his existence while blue gold brilliance regenerated what was lost. Both bodies burned. Both bodies reformed. Both bodies grew stronger with every nanosecond that passed.

But as the nanoseconds accumulated, something became clear to everyone watching.

He wasnt unraveling.

His causality remained intact. His existence continued despite being targeted by a Pulse that should have erased him entirely. THE Silurian Light burned and burned and burned, but the being it burned refused to be unwritten.

Noahs eyes opened wide on both bodies.

He looked out through flames that wreathed his existence, his gaze locking with Grimvault who stared back with utter incredulity and astonishment. Those pale fires in the wolf skull helm burned brighter than ever, but they burned with confusion rather than confidence.

"Merely THE Silurian Light."

His fists remained raised.

"It seems that I am already immune to it."

BOOM!

They operated on levels that normal authority couldnt touch, drew power from Causes that predated most current forces. Only another Pulse could potentially reverse or combat a Pulse!

But Noah hadnt cast any Pulses.

So how was he alive?

How was his causality intact?

How was he still standing there with flames wreathing his existence, defiant and unbroken and growing stronger with every nanosecond that passed?

Nobody here knew that he hadnt fought the Pulse itself. Hed fought the Cause behind it, had challenged THE Silurian Cause to prove its absolute superiority over THE Infinite Cause, and the Cause had been unable to provide that proof!

Naldine stared at him with a look of stupor.

In all her experience, across eons of existence among Primordial Architects and classifications that most couldnt imagine, she couldnt explain this. She didnt know what this was!

Chapter 5097: Destruction and Rebirth! II

Palm outward. Fingers spreading. The curling motion. The pulling. The rotation. The snap. The fist. The opening.

He was anchoring himself, using the multiplicative force of THE Octogenary Echo to replicate his current state eighty-one times in a single nanosecond, creating so many overlapping instances of his present existence that regression couldnt find purchase!

Oh!

His form stabilized.

The fluctuations ceased. The shifting between sizes stopped. Grimvault stood anchored in his current state, Axiom buried in his own chest, THE Silurian Light still streaming from his other hand to counter THE Infinite Light that continued pressing against his existence.

But his eyes.

Those pale fires burning in his wolf skull helms empty sockets stared at Noah with fury and shock and something else.

Something that Calymmian entities werent supposed to feel when facing beings at THE First Scale.

Whatever power Noah had utilized, which should somehow be a Pulse despite him having no right to possess one, could actually unravel him. Actually unravel him, regress his causality until his existence returned to states that preceded his current form, until his Civilization dissolved back into potential that had never been actualized.

Him!

A Calymmian Proterozoic Scale entity!

The realization pressed against his awareness with horror that made his Axiom-anchored form tremble despite its enforced stability!

Noah closed his eyes to feel the cycles of destruction and rebirth flowing through his existence. Each wave of flame from THE Silurian Light annihilated everything he was. Each surge of Quintessence Infiniforce and Observable Force rebuilt what had been destroyed. His obsidian titanic form floated nearby, Sammarthiel still flickering in Schrodingers Tomb behind him. His gaze held profundity as he stared at Noah, ancient eyes processing implications that would take time to fully comprehend.

His Enneagram pulsed with dangerous light, nine points blazing with authority that seemed more substantial than it had been before the battle began. Blood still stained his gloved hands from hours of work within Beowulfs chest cavity. His face still bore streaks of crimson gold fluid that he hadnt bothered to wipe away. But his expression held satisfaction.

When one looked at Beowulf, they understood why.

The massive Primordial Architect still hung suspended by nine spears, his body trembling and twitching in a daze. But something fundamental had changed. His network of Second Scale receptors and Nociceptors, that entire system Alexander had spent millions of subjective years studying through experiencing its torments, was gone.

Completely removed.

Transplanted into Alexanders own body, integrated into foundations that would never forget what those receptors had been used for. The tortured had become the possessor of the instrument of torture. The victim had claimed the weapon that had been used against him!

Alexander looked toward Noah.

Noah nodded in acknowledgment, then waved his hands toward Beowulfs suspended form. His will reached inward, touching THE Hadean Organ of Civilization that spun within his chest. A command was issued without verbal expression, authority directed toward the construct that made his impossible progression possible.

Another entrant into THE Hadean Desmoterion had appeared.

|Target: Beowulf, THE Primordial Architect of Armed Existence.|

|Current State: Heavily injured. Rhyacian Tier Proterozoic Scale. Network of Existential Nociceptors removed. Cognitive function severely impaired. Civilizational Anchor destabilized through prolonged torture.|

|Processing.|

The massive body of Beowulf began to dissolve.

His form, which had seemed so immense and threatening when he first arrived at this battlefield, turned into streams of crimson gold light that flowed toward Noahs position. The nine spears that had anchored him joined into one. His armor, his flesh, his Proterozoic Bones, all of it converted into luminous streams that crossed the distance between where hed been suspended and where Noah stood burning with magma-like flames.

The streams entered Noahs chest.

They flowed into THE Hadean Organ of Civilization, into THE Hadean Desmoterion contained within where he would be joining Ozymandias and THE Living Elemental and all others in that internal space.

|Imprisonment Complete.|

|Entity: Beowulf, THE Primordial Architect of Armed Existence.|

|Classification: Heavily injured Rhyacian Tier Proterozoic Lifeform.|

|Location: THE Hadean Desmoterion.|

|Status: Contained. Civilizational development will resume shortly.|

...!

Noah observed all of this as he breathed.

The cycles of destruction and rebirth continued without pause, THE Silurian Light still burning, blue gold brilliance still erupting with every nanosecond. But the battle was over now. The enemies were dealt with. Vahrkosis had been unraveled by Naldines Cambrian Word. Sammarthiel remained trapped in Schrodingers Tomb. Grimvault had fled through THE Interstices. Beowulf was imprisoned within his own existence.

Now he could simply focus on experiencing the cycles until their final culmination.

Both his bodies floated toward each other, the titanic form of Ozymandias and the smaller frame of his primary existence moving until they positioned back to back. They began to spin slowly, rotating in perfect synchrony as blasts of blue gold erupted around them in rhythm with the nanosecond cycles of destruction and rebirth.

All around them, seas of Observable Force gathered.

The connection to Eon continued flooding golden light into his existence at rates that made rivers seem like trickles. Quintessence Infiniforce generated endlessly within his foundations, providing resources that the transformation required. Infinity across Observable Existence responded to what was happening, his claims scattered throughout reality channeling support toward his evolution.

The multicolored rain fell.

The flames burned.

The cycles continued!

And across Observable Existence, a few beings who had witnessed what just occurred processed many implications.

It was the end of a shocking conflict that made one thing horribly clear.

Osmont, THE Infinity-bearer, had been attacked by a Calymmian Proterozoic Scale entity with a Pulse of The Scales. Hed been targeted for complete erasure by THE Silurian Light, the same authority that could unmake causality itself and erase beings until not even memory of them remained.

And he wasnt affected.

Hed even proclaimed immunity!

This...held far too many conclusions to draw.

Chapter 5098: Destruction and Rebirth! III

<Fragment of awareness attributed to THE Deliverance>

In spans that predated the concept of spans, THE Deliverance had observed the nature of advancement with attention that most beings could not sustain across even a fraction of such duration.

It had watched countless existences conflate two processes which were, upon examination that required no effort for something of its nature, quite fundamentally distinct from one another.

Transcendance and Ascension.

Transcendence referred to the elevation of existence beyond its current categorical limitations, the movement from one classification to another in ways that redefined what the being fundamentally was. Ascension represented advancement within ones existing classification, the refinement and expansion of capabilities without actually changing the foundational nature of the existence in question.

The distinction mattered. Those who failed to understand this failed at everything that followed.

A Primordial Architect who forged additional Proterozoic Bones, who cultivated new Organs, who progressed from Rhyacian to Calymmian to Ediacaran, this being was ascending. They grew more powerful. They remained what they always were. Their classification did not change; only their position within that classification elevated.

THE Deliverance had observed this process unfold across eons beyond counting, had watched beings celebrate advancements that changed nothing fundamental about their nature.

He had been foolish enough to ask before...if one desired to transform from THE Bounded status to THE Gilded status, would such a transformation be considered transcendence?

The asking itself long ago revealed his own fundamental misunderstanding of how existence had been woven.

It was not possible to transform from Bounded to Gilded.

This was not difficulty or a ceiling. The distinctions between Bounded and Gilded were established permanently, and those distinctions were permanent by design. They were not limitations to be overcome. They were definitions. One did not transcend a definition; one simply was or was not what the definition described.

Even if a Gilded Lifeform sealed themselves to live as Bounded. They walked among those they were engineered to surpass. They experienced limitations never meant for them. Even when they forgot what they truly were.

But forgetting changed nothing.

The seal suppressed expression. It did not alter engineering. Remove the seal, and what was always there reasserted itself. The Bounded lifeform beside them could remove a thousand seals and would remain precisely what they were at first breath: Bounded.

Limited by design. Constrained by intention that predated their existence by margins they could not comprehend.

This truth simply was. And those who failed to understand it would continue failing, as they always had, as they always would, until existence itself concluded its long and patient turning.

---

Existence breathes, and epochs pass, leaving Civilizations that become monuments, then crumble to memory, and are long forgotten when that breath comes again. In all these epochs, Infinity reigns supreme.

---

The entire region had transformed into something...unimaginable.

Tumultuous primordial seas of gold Observable Force stretched in every direction, waves crashing against waves in configurations that had nothing to do with gravity or current. Multicolored Quintessence Infiniforce wove through those golden seas like rivers of impossible light threading through an ocean that shouldnt have existed.

The destroyed battlefield was gone now, replaced by this churning expanse of raw authority that had gathered in response to what was occurring at its center.

Typhoons bloomed across the surface of these seas.

Storms of Observable Force twisted into spiraling columns that reached toward heights that most beings couldnt perceive, their rotation carrying enough power to obliterate Absolutes who strayed too close. Lightning made of Quintessence Infiniforce arced between the typhoons, connecting them in networks of multicolored brilliance that painted the entire region in hues of transformation and genesis.

And at the very center of it all, Noah could feel his body undergoing the last cycles of destruction and rebirth.

It was taking longer and longer for THE Silurian Light to be capable of destroying his atoms and cells. Dozens of nanoseconds before this, hed actually had to release any natural passive defenses, consciously lowering the resistance his transforming existence had developed. Otherwise, he might not have been able to undergo the cycles of destruction at all. The fire that had once threatened to erase him entirely now struggled to even damage cells that had been rebuilt so many times theyd forgotten what weakness felt like.

But finally, after cycles beyond counting, after transformation that had compressed eons into minutes, the moment arrived.

BOOM!

The magma-like light blazed for one last moment.

It pressed against his existence with everything it had remaining, that fire derived from THE Silurian Cause attempting one final assault on foundations that had grown too grand for it to damage. The flames cried out as if giving up, a sound that wasnt sound but rather the sensation of authority recognizing its own inadequacy.

And everything about it faded.

THE Silurian Light, the Pulse that Grimvault had unleashed to erase him, the fire that had scorched his existence through countless nanoseconds of destruction and rebirth, simply ceased. Its purpose had been exhausted. Its power had been absorbed. Nothing remained but the aftermath of what it had catalyzed!

Noah floated at the center of the primordial seas with his eyes closed.

His body still burned with residual heat that had nothing to do with the departed Pulse, warmth generated by transformation that was reaching its culmination. He raised his hands up, palms facing the churning sky of Observable Force that stretched above this impossible region.

HUUM!

His last cycle of destruction displayed itself to all who were watching.

His entire body broke apart into pure particles of Infinity and Observable Force, form dissolving into components so fundamental that they preceded the concept of form itself. Ozymandias underwent the same dissolution simultaneously, that titanic frame shattering into brilliance that matched what Noahs smaller body had become.

A blinding light bloomed across the primordial seas.

Even Alexander turned his eyes away from what he was witnessing. Naldine, who had observed phenomena across eons of existence among Primordial Architects, shielded her singularity-dotted gaze!

THE Primordial Paradox shifted his obsidian form away from the epicenter!

The light folded back.

Particles of Infinity and Observable Force that had scattered across the primordial seas began converging, drawn together.

They coalesced with purpose that declared their destination, streams of brilliance flowing toward a central point where form was being reconstructed from components that had been purified through cycles beyond counting.

Noahs body emerged from the convergence shining unfathomably gold.

His hair now radiated with multicolored light that shifted through hues as his existence settled into its new configuration. The strands seemed to contain depths that normal hair couldnt possess, each one blazing with Quintessence Infiniforce that had been integrated so thoroughly it had become part of his physical appearance.

His fair skin illuminated from within, golden light pressing outward through flesh that had been rebuilt at the subatomic level. The illumination wasnt harsh or aggressive. It simply was, the natural consequence of foundations saturated with Observable Force at densities that Bounded classification shouldnt have been able to contain.

And for a moment, momentarily visible to Naldine and all others present, the outline of his internal structure revealed itself through that illuminated skin.

An entirely crystalline multicolored golden skeleton.

Every bone blazed with brilliance that declared its transformation complete, structures that had once been mundane now existing as something that exceeded Proterozoic classification entirely. The skull. The spine. The ribcage. The pelvis.

Every arm bone and leg bone and hand bone and foot bone, all of them shining with authority that made the Proterozoic Bones of fallen Primordial Architects seem dim by comparison!

And apart from the skeleton, there were radiant crystalline Organs.

Chapter 5099: Information Is Critical!

Nakatsukunis deepest reaches.

Erwin stood before the structure where Sadakar resided, his beggar-like attire seeming almost offensive against the refined architecture surrounding him. Moloch floated beside him, golden plates spinning with consideration.

Both of them had paused before the doorway where Sabayne and Baalzan sat guard, their attention directed not at the entrance but upward toward the sky that stretched above this hidden domain.

The broadcast had been dispersed.

Grimvault had shattered the illusory screens that had been displaying his confrontation across Observable Existence, denying most beings the ability to witness what had occurred in THE Wastes. Very few possessed the capability to observe through such disruption. Very few could pierce the veil that a Calymmian Tier Primordial Architect had thrown across the event.

Moloch was one of them. His nature as a Singular Cognizance granted perception that others couldnt imagine.

And Erwin was another.

His existence as THE Information Paradox allowed him to consume information that others couldnt access. Even when that information was scattered, even when it was hidden, even when powerful entities actively worked to prevent its spread, the paradox he embodied could draw fragments toward himself through sheer contradiction of the principle that hidden things should remain hidden.

He didnt see the full picture.

The details were incomplete, the sequence of events fragmented in ways that made comprehensive understanding impossible. But he saw enough. He saw Grimvaults Silurian Light crash against an existence that should have been erased by it. He saw that existence survive. He saw a Pulse emerge in response, blue gold flames that made even his paradoxical perception struggle to process what they represented.

And he saw Grimvault flee.

Erwin smiled brilliantly.

His lips curved upward! Even with limited information, even with gaps in his observation that would have frustrated lesser beings, he could affirm one undeniable fact.

Osmont had somehow managed to push away a Calymmian Proterozoic Scale entity.

He had forced an entity who had existed since before most current powers learned to crawl to tear open THE Interstices and flee rather than continue the confrontation.

This made him tremendously happy.

Since his conversation with Osmont in that space between spaces, since revealing his nature as THE Information Paradox and watching his Infinite Seals interweave with the corrupted proto-matter of THE Fallout, before all of it had been erased with multicolored rain, Erwin had made a decision. He had changed his target for information gathering. Where before he had focused his paradoxical consumption on THE Creature, now his attention had shifted.

To Osmont.

Not because he believed Osmont was grander than THE Creature. That couldnt possibly be true. Or rather, he couldnt really know that with certainty.

THE Creature had existed for far to long and done far too much.

But his paradoxical intuition told him to make this change.

That intuition, which had guided him through eons of cultivation and consumption and contradiction, whispered that Osmont represented information worth gathering. Worth focusing on. Worth making the center of his attention rather than an entity whose patterns he had already observed across countless spans of existence.

And now, confirming what Osmont had just accomplished...

Erwin spoke commandingly, his voice emerging with authority that pressed against the stillness of Nakatsukunis deepest reaches.

"Harvest all the information of how Osmont has affected Observable Existence since then."

His words werent directed at anyone present. They were directed at himself, at the paradox he embodied, at the violation of information conservation that comprised his fundamental nature.

"Gather every fragment of how much potential he has taken and displayed in the surrounding existence. All the weavings that carry his signature. All the effects that trace back to his actions. All of it."

HUUM!

His body shone internally with paradoxical light.

The brilliance existed and didnt exist simultaneously, illumination that was also darkness, visibility that was also concealment. Information began flooding toward his existence in torrents that made even his eons-refined foundations tremble. He felt the consumption begin, felt the paradox draw in everything related to Osmonts effects on Observable Existence.

And what flooded toward him almost made him shudder.

The amount was ridiculous. The density was overwhelming. Information about Osmonts Infinity spreading across realms. Information about his Seals now interweaving with THE Fallout. Information about Civilizations and Undivided Ones and Formless Terrors who had been affected by his emergence. Information about The Pluvial Epoch of Existential Infinity he actually formed alongside THE Creature, and so much more!

Instead of releasing this information outward as he normally would, instead of letting it spread as weavings that carried his signature alongside their original essence, Erwin released all of it into...himself.

He sat down in a meditative position.

His beggar-like form settled against the ground before Sadakars structure, legs crossing beneath him as the paradoxical light within his existence intensified. Sabayne and Baalzan watched him with expressions that mixed confusion and wariness, clearly uncertain what THE Living Paradox was doing at their doorstep.

But Erwin paid them no attention.

His Civilizational Anchor was settling.

He could feel it happening. The information he had just consumed, the sheer magnitude of Osmonts effects on Observable Existence, provided the final weight needed to push his paradox past the threshold he had been approaching for so long.

Apart from this, endless paradoxical Observable Force began flooding into him.

Golden light mixed with the contradictory brilliance already burning within his foundations, power that came from sources he couldnt immediately identify but didnt question. His cultivation accelerated in ways that felt almost unfair!

Erwin opened his eyes with wonder that he rarely allowed himself to feel.

Just what was Osmont?

How was merely the information related to him and his effect on surrounding existence this grand? He hadnt consumed Osmont himself. He had only gathered information about Osmonts effects, about how his existence rippled outward through Observable Existence, about the changes his emergence had created across existence.

And that alone had been sufficient to push him past the threshold of Civilizational Anchor.

Erwin shook his head slowly. He focused on his rapid elevation of power, on the forces flooding into his existence with intensity. His paradox burned brighter than ever, contradiction and confirmation dancing within foundations that were transforming into something grander with every passing moment.

Above him, Moloch floated with golden plates spinning faster than normal.

The Singular Cognizance seemed thoughtful. Only now did Moloch seem to truly notice Erwin, attention shifting from whatever he had been contemplating to focus on the entity sitting in meditation below him.

A heavy power was erupting from THE Living Paradox.

Molochs plates slowed as that power pressed against his perception, as the advancement occurring within Erwin announced itself to everything nearby. The Singular Cognizance had brought Erwin here to make difficult allies, to secure partnerships with entities who had rejected conflict. He hadnt expected his companion to achieve a breakthrough on the doorstep of their destination.

And neither Moloch nor Erwin knew what waited just beyond the doorway they stood outside of.

On the other side of that entrance, within the stellar darkness of Sadakars structure, another body of Noah Osmont stood. The very entity whose information had just catalyzed Erwins breakthrough was right there, separated from them by nothing more than wood and stone and the power of Sadakar who separated them!

The Peasant and the Infinity-bearer, about to meet again!

Chapter 5100: Experimentation I

Noah gazed toward Ozymandias.

His second body floated nearby in that transformed obsidian form, crystalline structures now visible beneath flesh that radiated the same golden brilliance his primary body displayed. They had undergone the same evolution through the same cycles of destruction and rebirth, both existences now Hadean in classification.

He sent the command through THE Hadean Organ of Civilization.

Ozymandias dissolved into streams of blue gold light that flowed across the tumultuous seas of Observable Force surrounding them. Those streams entered Noahs chest, returning to THE Hadean Desmoterion where the titanic form would cultivate until needed again.

Noah looked at his hands.

Golden light still pressed outward through skin that seemed luminescent rather than merely fair. Everything about his existence felt different now, grander in ways he was still learning to comprehend.

Just what had his power reached at this time?

And what did it truly mean to be a Hadean Lifeform?

He turned his attention inward, directing his question inward.

"Ruination...am I still considered a Bounded Lifeform?"

The response came calmly.

|I find myself perceiving and obtaining information from our surroundings at rates that exceed my previous capacity by factors I am still calculating. Dozens of times faster, certainly. Dozens of times denser in the quality of what I can observe. The transformation you have undergone has elevated my own capabilities tremendously.|

A pause that felt contemplative rather than hesitant.

|As for your question regarding classification, the answer is not as simple as you might hope. You cannot be considered a Bounded Lifeform any longer. The limitations that define Bounded existence, the ceilings engineered into their foundations, the restrictions that prevent them from accessing Observable Force at densities reserved for higher classifications, none of these apply to you in your current state.|

|However, you are not a Gilded Lifeform either. The engineering that distinguishes Gilded from Bounded was not something you possessed at birth, and becoming Hadean has not retroactively granted you that engineering. You have achieved something else entirely, something that exists in territories I do not have sufficient reference points to map with confidence.|

|Even saying you exist between Bounded and Gilded may not be entirely accurate. You are Hadean. This classification seems to operate according to principles that do not align neatly with the spectrum that places Bounded at one end and Gilded at the other. It is rather difficult to measure your current state in terms of difference between those two categories.|

|What I can state definitively is this: as of right now, you remain lower than a Gilded Lifeform such as Ubergulden Adelheid. Her engineering grants her advantages that your transformation, impressive as it is, has not replicated. But the gap between you and such entities has narrowed considerably, and given your trajectory, I would not assume that gap to be permanent.|

...!

Right.

Ubergulden Adelheid.

Noah let that name roll through his awareness with consideration it deserved. Such a strange and grand name for someone who had presented herself as THE Secretive Eon, who had sealed her Gilded nature to live as Bounded. The cadence of the name suggested origins and traditions he knew nothing about, cultures among THE Gilded that existed beyond what his current knowledge could encompass.

She had been providing him Observable Force throughout his transformation. That connection still pulsed with warmth.

"Tell me more about her," Noah said. "About Ubergulden Adelheid and what youve learned through our connection."

|I have been conducting a silent and secret analysis of her existence through the link she established, and I am pleased to report that sufficient examination has been completed to allow for meaningful interaction. Her engineering remains perceivable to your newly unlocked Existential Engineering capability.|

|Most relevantly for your immediate circumstances, you now possess the ability to communicate with her directly. The connection she established flows in both directions, and with your enhanced processing capabilities, you can easily send a message through that link for her to hear. Whether she chooses to respond, of course, remains her decision to make.|

...!

Well, that was something.

He filed that capability away for future use, recognizing that such communication would need to be approached with care given how little he still understood about her.

While he was thinking about all of this, movement drew his attention outward.

Naldine Manthon floated toward him through the tumultuous seas of Observable Force. Her singularity-dotted eyes blazed with intensity, ancient perception clearly working through what she was observing. She circled him slowly, her radiant white hair trailing behind her as she moved, her expression holding something between fascination and confusion.

She reached out and lifted his arm.

Her fingers pressed against his transformed flesh as if testing its composition, as if checking whether his structure matched what her senses were telling her. She turned his hand over, examined his palm, traced lines across his skin that seemed to follow pathways only she could perceive.

"What... are you, really?"

The question emerged with genuine bewilderment that she didnt bother concealing.

Noah smiled at the familiar inquiry. He felt like he had been asked this before, many times, by entities across various classifications who couldnt reconcile what they observed with what they understood to be possible.

Now Naldine Manthon asked the same question with the same inability to find satisfying answers.

He clenched his fist, feeling the power that coursed through transformed flesh and Hadean bone.

His voice hels confidence that pressed against the surrounding seas of Observable Force.
