...!

Naldines eyes became sharp at these words. The Vihuela formed from her own arm began to hum with authority that announced her classification to everything nearby.

Before she could reply, movement from another direction drew both their attention.

THE Primordial Paradox floated toward them through the multicolored seas, his massive obsidian form cutting through the tumultuous Observable Force. Behind him, pulled by chains of paradoxical light, Schrodingers Tomb drifted in his wake. Sammarthiel remained trapped within that uncertainty, flickering between alive and dead without resolution.

The ancient being looked at Noah with seriousness that his obsidian features somehow conveyed despite their inhuman nature.

"Youngest."

His voice pressed against everything nearby.

"I have returned after eons of absence, and I have much to catch up on in Helheim among other places. Old debts to collect or repay depending on how the accounting has shifted during my imprisonment."

He paused, his gaze holding something that might have been respect.

"I will keep in touch."

Noah nodded at him with a smile.

"Stay safe," Noah said. "For existence is vast and full of terrors."

...!

THE Primordial Paradox laughed at such words as he had said them himself what seemed like eons ago!

His obsidian form shook with that laughter, paradoxical light flickering across his features.

"Indeed it is, Youngest. Indeed it is!"

He turned away, pulling on the chains that connected him to Schrodingers Tomb. The massive prison of uncertainty drifted behind him as he moved toward the edge of the tumultuous seas, toward regions where the multicolored rain of THE Pluvial Epoch fell with intensity.

And then he disappeared into that rain, his obsidian form swallowed by cascading brilliance while dragging a Rhyacian Tier Primordial Architect trapped in paradoxical uncertainty behind him.

Alexander looked between Noah and Naldine.

His Enneagram pulsed with the dangerous light it had held since completing his work on Beowulf, nine points blazing with authority that seemed more substantial than it had been before this battle began. The network of Second Scale Existential Nociceptors now integrated into his existence hummed with potential that would take time to fully realize.

He let out a sigh of peace.

It was a strange sound coming from someone who had spent millions of subjective years being tortured, someone whose entire existence had been defined by agony inflicted by the entity now imprisoned within Noahs chest. But the sigh carried contentment.

"I know my limits and what can happen now."

His voice held calm that matched the peaceful sigh.

"While I wont do too much, wont overextend myself into situations I cant handle, I feel like hunting Primordial Architects. There are many across Observable Existence who operate like Beowulf did. Many who deserve what I will bring to them."

His eyes met Noahs with understanding that didnt require elaboration.

"If I meet a wall that is too sturdy, I will let you know."

Noah nodded at these words with a smile. Alexander had his own path now, his own trajectory that would carry him toward heights that most couldnt imagine reaching. The receptors of a Second Scale entity transplanted into his existence would provide advantages others couldnt imagine as his foundation!

"Hunt well," Noah said simply.

Alexander turned and walked into the multicolored seas surrounding them. His figure moved through the tumultuous Observable Force with purpose, his form gradually becoming obscured as endless rain buffeted his existence from every direction. THE Pluvial Epochs downpour swallowed him just as it had swallowed THE Primordial Paradox, leaving no trace of his passage.

Noah watched him go.

With the receptors of a Second Scale transplanted into him, Alexanders power would be experiencing a tremendous curve. He simply had to avoid meeting ridiculous adversity like Horus and Beowulf had represented, entities who exceeded him so vastly that even his new advantages couldnt bridge the gap.

But he had his own path.

And that path was his to walk.

Only Noah and Naldine remained in this region now.

The tumultuous seas of Observable Force churned around them, golden brilliance mixing with multicolored Quintessence Infiniforce. The typhoons still spiraled in the distance. The lightning still arced between storm systems. And two beings floated at the center of it all, one newly transformed and one ancient beyond comprehension.

Noah turned to face Naldine fully.

"Are you ready, Naldine Manthon?"

His voice carried challenge that pressed against her existence!

"You have always been so high and mighty, looking at me from classifications I couldnt reach, speaking of dangers I couldnt understand. I wish to see if I am still far from you, or whether in our short time together, I have gone ahead of you."

...!

He smiled devilishly as he said this. His multicolored hair blazed brighter. His golden skin illuminated with intensity that made looking at him difficult!

His pupils, shining like singularities of an unfathomable Cause, fixed upon her with attention that didnt waver.

Naldine looked at him with sharp eyes.

The Vihuela in her hands buzzed with authority that exceeded what she had displayed during the battle against Grimvault and his companions. Her singularity-dotted gaze held something between anticipation and wariness, ancient existence recognizing that the being before her was no longer what he had been when she first agreed to teach him!

She floated away from him, putting distance between them that combat would require.

"Since my perception cannot fully understand you, I wont be taking it easy."

Her voice carried seriousness that matched her expression.

"Whatever you have become, it exists in territories I cannot map. And things I cannot map are things that can hurt me if I underestimate them."

...!

Billowing power began to gather around her.

Observable Force flooded toward her...and blue infinity faintly shone inside her. Her Proterozoic Bones blazed with authority that pressed against the tumultuous seas surrounding them. Her Proterozoic Organs pulsed with rhythms!

Truly, she seemed to be past the door of Calymmian Proterozoic Scale.

Noah nodded at her words seriously.

"Oh, you definitely should not take it easy."

His voice pressed against existence itself.

"Otherwise, you may not survive."

BOOM!

He simply took a step forward.

And existence itself shook as if he was commanding all the Observable Force nearby, as if his movement had become authority that reality couldnt ignore. The tumultuous seas parted around him!

The typhoons in the distance stuttered in their rotation. The lightning froze mid-arc as if waiting to see what would happen next!

Oh!

Chapter 5101: Experimentation II

In THE Infiniverse.

The Early Veiled Shore stretched before Noahs perception with magisterial beauty that felt almost absurd given everything happening across Observable Existence!

Vibrant golden sand lined the beach where waves of crystalline water lapped against shores that had never known pollution or corruption. Inland, plots of multicolored farmland spread across gentle hills, sacred herbs of every variety growing vibrantly.

The multicolored rain of THE Pluvial Epoch of Existential Infinity continued even here.

Droplets of impossible brilliance fell, nourishing everything they touched with Quintessence Infiniforce that accelerated growth and enhanced potency. The herbs seemed to lean toward the rain as it fell, leaves spreading wider to catch more of what descended upon them.

On a plot filled with mystical floating lotuses, Noah stood with attention fixed on something far more interesting than sacred herbs.

Another body of his had just begun sparring with Naldine Manthon in the tumultuous seas of Observable Force that THE Wastes had become. That confrontation would test the limits of his Hadean transformation against someone who stood past the door of Calymmian classification. But this body, this consciousness operating within THE Infiniverse itself, had different work to accomplish.

Critical work.

A floating platform of soft luminescent material hovered among the mystical lotuses, their multicolored petals releasing fragrances that would have intoxicated lesser beings. And on that platform lay Barbatos.

Her short stature seemed almost delicate against the soft surface supporting her, dark hair splayed outward in waves that caught the light of Infinity.

That hair seemed to drink in the multicolored rain, strands glistening with moisture that carried power most beings couldnt safely absorb. Her voluptuous figure was adorned in nothing but a loose white robe that revealed curves that drew attention regardless of how many times he had seen them.

She was breathing with relief now, chest rising and falling as she recovered from what he had just done.

He had pulled her from Yggdrheim without warning, extracted her from challenges she had been navigating within that realm of trials and tribulations.

Her dark eyes opened to look at him with an expression mixing curiosity and something more suggestive.

"When you pulled me away from Yggdrheim while saying you wanted to try something, I had an entirely different idea in mind regarding what we would be trying."

...!

"I imagined candles, perhaps. Certainly not being placed on a table like a specimen awaiting dissection."

She propped herself up on her elbows, the movement causing her robe to shift mesmerizingly.

"What exactly are you planning on doing, Little Fish?"

Little Fish.

She still used this term regardless of how his power had grown, and he found comfort in that consistency all the way from his time in Atlantis!

It was surreal to think about his time years ago as an Atlantean fighting demons.

Noahs eyes were already shining like golden singularities as he looked at her.

"I want to see if I have what it takes to be an Engineer."

...!

An Engineer.

Because he had gained the capability of Existential Engineering through his Hadean transformation. The ability to perceive the fundamental makeup of existence, to see the weavings that comprised beings at their most basic level, to potentially modify those weavings according to his will. He had not yet tested this capability, had not yet attempted to actually engineer anything.

He wanted to experiment now.

It seemed like something pivotal, a capability that could reshape how he approached advancement for himself and those connected to him. And this moment was as good as any to begin understanding what Existential Engineering truly allowed.

And this was a unqiue period.

Noah loved the relaxing period after major adversity.

Such times allowed him to breathe and gauge just how much he had grown. They provided space for experimentation, for exploration, for testing new capabilities without the pressure of enemies trying to kill him while he learned. Periods like this were rare. Sometimes he went from adversity to adversity without rest, from battle to breakthrough to battle again in cycles that left no room for contemplation.

One needed rest every now and then.

And his version of resting was keeping himself busy with work that didnt involve immediate mortal danger.

Right now, that meant staring at the body of Barbatos with eyes that perceived existence differently than they ever had before.

"Lie back," he said softly.

She complied with curiosity burning in her dark eyes, settling against the soft platform while watching him with attention that missed nothing. Her robe shifted again as she moved, but neither of them paid that any mind. This was not about intimacy. This was about something potentially far more significant.

Noah brought his hands forward.

His palms pressed against various points of Barbatoss body in a purposeful manner, fingers finding positions that his newly awakened perception identified as significant. Golden Observable Force gathered in one hand. Multicolored Quintessence Infiniforce gathered in the other. Both energies danced from his fingertips, entering her body through pathways that only Existential Engineering could perceive.

Barbatos closed her eyes and bit her lip.

The sensation was clearly stimulating. Her fingers curled against the soft platform beneath her. But she did her best to focus, to remain still, because she could see that Noah was serious about whatever he was attempting.

He infused her with tendrils of both forces, threading power through her existence!

And then he saw it.

A network of vibrant vessel-like pathways lit up across her entire body, illuminating beneath her skin in patterns that revealed the fundamental architecture of her existence.

Ethereal channels branched throughout her form like rivers feeding into tributaries feeding into streams.

Primary conduits ran along her spine and through her heart, connecting to secondary pathways that spread toward her extremities. Tertiary networks webbed between those secondary channels, creating interconnected systems that touched every part of her existence. Nodes of concentrated energy marked junctions where multiple pathways intersected, some burning bright while others barely flickered.

Her Civilization of Necromancy wove through these networks in intricate musings, death-aspected authority filled with Bounded Countable Infinity coloring the channels it had claimed.

But as Noah observed with eyes that could finally perceive such depths, he noticed something that made his expression shift.

The networks looked dim!

Chapter 5102: Experimentation III

|I have completed preliminary analysis of the subjects Existential Engineering.|

Ruinations voice emerged.

|What you perceive before you is the Lattice of Foundational Constraint. This is the basal, most basic perceivable engineering to you currently that defines Bounded Lifeforms, the architecture that was thr blueprint woven into their existence. The network you observe represents the channels through which power should flow and the nodes where that power should accumulate.|

|In Bounded existence, these channels are narrow. The nodes are dimmed. The potential for expansion exists within the architecture, but limitations prevent that expansion from occurring regardless of how much power the subject attempts to cultivate. It is the base template of Existences that will ever be born in Observable Existence.|

HUUM!

|The subject Barbatos displays this Lattice of Foundational Constraint in typical Bounded configuration. Her Civilization and your infinity has optimized what can be optimized within these limitations, but she cannot exceed what she was engineered to be. The channels will not widen. The nodes will not brighten. The ceilings will not lift regardless of her efforts or desires.|

|However.|

|Through Existential Engineering, it is theoretically possible to alter this seemingly preset and unchangeable construct. The limitations are just that, which means they can be removed or modified by one possessing sufficient capability and power. If you were to flood her Lattice with Observable Force and Quintessence Infiniforce and overwhelm the constraints, you could potentially reshape her engineering toward something approaching Hadean classification.|

|I should note that this would not immediately transform her into a full Hadean Lifeform. Her bones and organs would remain in their current state until she undergoes the transformation process that you experienced. But her engineering would be altered to permit such transformation, to allow her existence to grow toward classifications that Bounded existence normally cannot achieve.|

|If successful, she would be designated as a Nascent Hadean. A Hadean Lifeform that has not yet grown to full maturity but possesses the potential to do so. The engineering of a Hadean without the completed physical transformation. A seedling rather than a tree.|

...!

Noah absorbed this information with eyes that blazed brighter by the moment.

A Nascent Hadean.

The possibility of granting others the potential he had achieved through cycles of destruction and rebirth that most couldnt survive. If he could reshape Bounded engineering through Existential Engineering, if he could remove the limitations that prevented his companions from advancing beyond their designated ceilings...

His hands began to vibrate with immensity.

One hand shone gold with endless Observable Force. The other shone multicolored with endless Quintessence Infiniforce, the energy of his transformation gathering with density that pressed against everything nearby.

He looked down at Barbatos.

"This may be intense," he said simply.

Her dark eyes met his with trust that didnt waver.

"Go on, Little Fish. Do what you need to do."

Noah pressed both hands against her heart.

He began to flood both forces into her existence, Observable Force and Quintessence Infiniforce pouring through her Lattice of Foundational Constraint in torrents that exceeded anything she had ever experienced. The power pressed against their walls. It pushed against the narrowing. It demanded expansion that the engineering had been designed to prevent!

Barbatos opened her eyes wide.

Her hand shot out to grasp onto his robe. Her chest heaved as her breathing became ragged, back arching off the platform as sensations cascaded through her existence in waves she couldnt control!

"Ah..!"

BOOM!

Immense concentrations flooded into her engineering.

The Lattice of Foundational Constraint resisted at first, limitations pushing back against the power attempting to reshape them. But Noah didnt relent. He poured more Observable Force into the gold hand, more Quintessence Infiniforce into the multicolored hand, overwhelming the resistance through sheer magnitude of what he provided.

|Engineering modification in progress. The Lattice of Foundational Constraint is experiencing forced expansion. Primary channels widening by factor of twelve. Secondary channels widening by factor of eight. Tertiary networks restructuring to accommodate increased flow capacity.|

|Nodes of concentrated energy are brightening. Junction points that previously flickered weakly are now blazing with intensity approaching what I observe in your own engineering. The artificial dimming is being overwritten.|

|Subject is experiencing significant sensation as her existence restructures around new parameters. The engineering that defined her for her entire existence is being rewritten in real time. Such alteration cannot occur without the subject being aware of what is happening to them.|

|Modification continuing. Seventy-three percent complete.|

Barbatos trembled beneath his hands.

Golden light began emanating from her skin, Observable Force flooding through channels that could suddenly accommodate its presence. Her dark hair started shifting, strands that had been purely black now showing rivers of gold running through them like veins of precious metal through stone. Her breathing came in gasps that released mist tinged with golden luminescence.

|Eighty-nine percent complete.|

|Ninety-four percent complete.|

|Modification complete.|

Noah slowly withdrew his hands.

The figure of Barbatos lay on the floating platform looking unfathomably beautiful! Her dark hair spread across the soft surface in waves now threaded with rivers of gold Observable Force, the coloring permanent rather than temporary. Her skin held luminescence that hadnt been there before, subtle but undeniable illumination pressing outward from within.

And on her forehead, a barely discernible golden crack could be seen.

It looked like a line of fracture in porcelain, except instead of damage it suggested emergence. Something breaking through from beneath. Something that had been constrained finally finding expression in physical form!

Her gaze was dazed and heavy as she breathed out golden mist with each exhale.

She rose slowly to sit on the soft floating platform. Around her body, rivers of golden Observable Force surged in currents that responded to her presence, power that her existence could suddenly channel in ways that had been impossible moments before.

"Little Fish..."

Her voice emerged breathless.

"What did you just do?"

...!

|Coomplete success has been observed in the modification of subject Barbatoss Existential Engineering.|

|Her previous designation as a Bounded Lifeform is no longer accurate. The Lattice of Foundational Constraint has been replaced with what I shall term the Lattice of Nascent Emergence. Her channels have been widened to accommodate power flow at rates previously impossible for her classification. Her nodes have been brightened to store energy in concentrations that would have destroyed her former engineering. The artificial limitations that defined her existence have been removed.|

|She is now designated as a Nascent Hadean.|

|In practical terms, this means she is capable of beginning the refinement of her bones and organs toward full Hadean classification. The transformation you underwent through cycles of destruction and rebirth, she can now pursue. The ceiling that would have prevented such advancement no longer exists.|

|I should note several significant implications of this change.|

|First, a Nascent Hadean exists in territories that blur the line between THE First Scale and THE Second Scale. She has not established a Civilizational Anchor, but she now possesses potential that exceeds what establishing such an Anchor would normally provide. The Hadean Organs and Bones she can eventually form will be grander than the Proterozoic Organs and Bones that others form upon reaching THE Second Scale. She will, in essence, be able to achieve Hadean classification at THE First Scale, then carry that enhanced foundation into THE Second Scale if she chooses to establish her Anchor.|

|Second, the golden crack visible on her forehead represents the physical manifestation of her altered engineering. This marking will evolve as she progresses toward full Hadean transformation, eventually becoming something more elaborate as her existence fully integrates the changes you have implemented.|

|Third, her connection to you has deepened significantly through this process. The Observable Force and Quintessence Infiniforce you used to reshape her engineering now exists within her foundations as permanent presence. She is, in a very real sense, partially composed of your power now.|

|This was a successful first application of Existential Engineering. The methodology you employed intuitively appears to have been correct. Future applications may require adjustment based on subject variation, but the fundamental approach has proven viable.|

Noah read over all of this as Barbatos continued breathing heavily beside him, her existence acclimating to parameters that had just been completely rewritten.

He brought his vibrant right hand forward.

His palm cradled her head, fingers supporting the back of her skull while his hand covered all of her cheek. The touch was gentle despite the power still radiating from his transformed flesh. She looked at him with dark gold eyes that hadnt been gold before, that shone with brilliance reflecting the Observable Force now flowing through her existence.

She cuddled against his hand to feel his warmth.

"What... have you done, Little Fish?"

She asked again as even her own existence couldnt believe itself!

<Personal Reflections from THE Grimoire of Hadean Lexicon, Author: Noah Osmont, written during the span known as THE Reckoning of Imposed Order>

"I have often reflected upon the nature of pivotal moments, and I have come to understand that they rarely announce themselves with the fanfare one might expect. The grand turning points of existence, the instants where the trajectory of reality itself shifts toward weavings that will define eons yet to come, these moments tend to arrive quietly, dressed in the mundane clothing of ordinary action, revealing their true significance only when observed through the lens of considerable retrospection.

When I performed my first Nascent Hadean transformation upon Barbatos in the Early Veiled Shore, I believed I was conducting an experiment. A test of newly acquired capabilities. An exploration of what Existential Engineering might allow me to accomplish for those I cared about. I did not understand, could not have understood at that time, that I was striking the first blow against an architecture of existence that had governed Causes and Observable Existences since before many of us learned to perceive ourselves as existing.

I actually threw the first punch without realizing it.

That moment marked one of the last periods of relative peace I would experience.

I do have to confess, with the clarity that distance and time provides, that my ignorance was profound. I knew, of course, that the distinctions between Bounded and Gilded were permanent by design. But knowing that something is designed and understanding why it was designed, understanding who benefits from that design and what they will do to preserve it, these are different forms of knowledge entirely.

But even if I had known, I would have still done the same. Because who decided things had to be this way? What gave them the right? What ordained them to have any capability at all?

The engineering that constrains Bounded existence was not so much as artificially implemented...as much as it was simply nature. Just how existence was. There wasnt something singular that could be said to be responsible. Existence simply was. Existence was...unfair. But it was structure an there were those who enjoyed such structure.

Those who sit atop structures of existentially imposed hierarchy rarely perceive their position as imposed. To them, the structure is natural and inevitable. The way things have always been and therefore the way things must always be.

The Bounded are Bounded because that is what they are. The Gilded are Gilded because that is what they are. And the Primeval, those ancient arbiters whose hands observed and directed Causes and studied and sought to manipulate the very engineering I was beginning to unravel, they exist beyond both because existence itself demands that someone must.

There was no good or evil. There was and is always what one believes.

When one alters the status quo, when one demonstrates that the limitations could be altered from below, when one proves that ceilings can be shattered and floors can be raised and the entire edifice of carefully maintained separation can be restructured through sufficient will and power, those who have benefited from that status quo tend to fight back.

They fight back because their position, their identity, their very understanding of their own significance depends upon the continued existence of those beneath them. A Gilded Lifeform is only Gilded in relation to the Bounded they surpass. Remove that relation, blur that distinction, demonstrate that the Bounded can become something that rivals or exceeds what the Gilded were engineered to be, and you do not merely threaten their power as you... threaten their meaning.

And to them, meaning is everything. For this, I pity Ubergulden Adelheid. I pity Ubergulden Markhus.

I did not know this when I placed my hands upon Barbatos and reshaped her engineering. I did not know that the peace I enjoyed in that moment, the relative calm of experimentation and discovery and the quiet joy of elevating someone I loved, would be one of the last moments of such peace I would experience before storms arrived that made Grimvault and his companions seem like gentle rain.

At that time, I truly did not know.

But I learned. Oh, how thoroughly I learned. And from all of it...endless seas of Observable and Unobservable Blood shall bloom. Existence will shudder, for it deserves to. All of Existence...deserves what is coming."

Chapter 5103: Parts To Play! I

Prima Indifferentia.

Grimvault tore through the boundaries between spaces with desperation he hadnt felt in eons, his massive armored form trailing destruction through layers of existence that parted before his authority!

He had run far, farther than a Calymmian Tier Primordial Architect should ever need to run!

But THE fucking Infinite Light still burned around him.

He ran towards...home.

After an unknown period of time and a shift between spaces and a unique methodology...

WAP!

He appeared above an endlessly stretching white gold sea, the surface reflecting illumination that seemed to come from everywhere and nowhere simultaneously.

SPLASH!

His massive figure crashed into the white gold waters, that blackened silver armor that had fused with his flesh now wreathed in blue gold flames that refused to extinguish regardless of what he submerged them in.

The sea parted around him, waves spreading outward from his impact.

THE Infinite Light sought to unwind him.

He could feel it working against his existence even now! His form had stopped fluctuating only because hed anchored himself again and again with his own Axiom, but the flames continued burning, continued trying to drag him backward through stages of development he had surpassed eons ago.

He had constantly enacted THE Silurian Light to counter it.

Pulse against Pulse. Fire against fire. But such deployment drained resources that even his ninety-four percent Proterozoic Bone saturation couldnt replenish indefinitely. He could still cast it a few more times, could continue the struggle between his Pulse and Osmonts...

But he didnt want to continue risking it.

He had many different points of strength, and raw power was only one of them. Intelligence was another. Experience was another. And connection, alliance, the bonds forged across eons of service to something greater than himself, these too were strength that could be leveraged when individual capability proved insufficient!

He was connected to THE Deliverance.

A Civilization thrived from alliances and communication. No being, regardless of how powerful they became, could stand entirely alone against the vastness of existence.

He had served THE Deliverance faithfully. He had executed their directives. He had enforced their will. He had been their instrument when instruments were required!

Now he would call upon that service.

Grimvault rose from the white gold waters, his massive form dripping with liquid. The blue gold flames still wreathed his existence, still pressed against his anchored state with hunger that wouldnt relent. He raised his arms toward the skies.

His voice emerged!

"I call upon bonds. I have never called for aid in all my spans of service..."

His pale fires blazed brighter beneath that wolf skull helm.

"I call now. Let THE Deliverance hear. Let THE Deliverance answer. Let THE Deliverance come forth and witness what has been wrought upon one who serves without question."

HUUM!

The seas churned quietly.

The white gold waters that had been merely trembling now began to rotate, currents forming that had nothing to do with natural flow and everything to do with power gathering in response to his invocation.

And it was unfathomably fast!

BOOM!

A dozen figures appeared before Grimvault.

Every single one radiated the terrifying aura of Primordial Architects at classifications that made his own Calymmian status seem modest. They floated above the churning waters in formations that suggested hierarchy. Some burned with fires of various colors. Others pulsed with authority that pressed against reality itself. All of them observed Grimvault with different gazes!

But the foremost figure drew his gaze entirely.

Platinum flames surrounded a humanoid titan whose form couldnt be fully observed through the brilliance that shrouded him!

The fire didnt merely burn around this entity. It seemed to emerge from him, to be part of what he was rather than something he wielded.

This was THE Deliverance.

Grimvault trembled before that presence.

His massive armored form, which had seemed so imposing when he confronted Osmont, now felt small and insignificant before the entity he had served across eons. He looked down with shame that pressed against his ancient existence, unable to meet the gaze of THE Deliverance or the gazes of others assembled here.

He had fled and had run from a being at THE First Scale. He had been driven to invoke aid he had never needed before!

The shame burned worse than THE Infinite Light still wreathing his form.

And yet...

"No need to feel shame for what happened, Grimvault."

THE Deliverances voice emerged deep enough to resonate through Grimvaults foundations, through the white gold sea beneath them!

The words carried understanding rather than condemnation.

"Existence is filled with anomalies that even we cannot account for. The Infinity-bearer has proven himself to be precisely such an anomaly, and there is no disgrace in doing what you did."

The platinum flames flickered with something that might have been curiosity.

"Now, this is the Pulse you cannot erase? How does it feel?"

...!

Grimvault looked up with gratitude that he couldnt fully express. The understanding in THE Deliverances words, the lack of judgment despite his failure, it meant more than he could articulate!

He gathered himself, forcing his voice to emerge as calmly as he could manage given the circumstances.

"It feels like...regression, Sir. Like being pulled backward through every stage of development I have achieved across eons. The flames demand that I return to states I surpassed before most current powers existed. They seek to unwind my causality until I am reduced to something that precedes what I currently am."

He paused, the blue gold flames still dancing across his armored form.

"I have countered with THE Silurian Light repeatedly, but the Pulses seem evenly matched. Neither can overcome the other through direct confrontation. And I found myself unwilling to continue the expenditure when the outcome remained uncertain."

THE Deliverance nodded slowly, that massive form shifting within its shroud of platinum brilliance.

"THE Infinite Light, so he called it? A new Pulse never before seen...."

The platinum flames intensified.

"I understand. And I shall demonstrate how such a Pulse can be countered for future reference."

THE Deliverance raised three hands.

Grimvault blinked as he hadnt realized the entity possessed more than two arms until that moment. Or...he just had the arms he needed to have at any time?

Three palms faced outward simultaneously, each one beginning the somatic components of different Pulses at the same time.

"THE Infinite Light operates on the principle of singular causality," THE Deliverance explained as his hands moved through gestures that overlapped without interfering with each other.

"It asserts a unique unknown Cause holds authority over those who lack its...brilliance, is it? But no single Cause holds authority over all others. When multiple Causes are invoked simultaneously, when their authorities overlap and interweave, the singular assertion of THE Infinite Light becomes diffused across contradictions it cannot resolve."

His first hand completed its gesture.

"THE Silurian Light provides the fire of primordial ignition."

His second hand completed its gesture.

"THE Cambrian Word provides the authority of rewritten consequence."

His third hand completed its gesture.

"And THE Ediacaran Silence provides the void where Causes cannot reach."

BOOM!

Three Pulses emerged simultaneously.

...!

He...did not say any of the lengthy words required!

Flames of impossible colors, inscriptions of reality-rewriting authority, and absolute absence of sound and presence all manifested at once, weaving together in configurations that shouldnt have been possible. The triple Pulse descended upon Grimvaults burning form, not attacking him but enveloping him in contradictions that THE Infinite Light couldnt navigate.

The blue gold flames flickered.

They pressed against the triple authority surrounding Grimvault, seeking purchase against existence that was being protected by three Causes asserting three different claims over reality. THE Infinite Light demanded regression, but THE Silurian Light declared that its fire preceded all regression. THE Cambrian Word rewrote the consequence of THE Infinite Lights contact. And THE Ediacaran Silence created space where no Pulse could reach regardless of its origin.

The flames began to fade!

Blue gold brilliance that had burned for spans since Grimvault fled THE Wastes finally extinguished, dissolving into the white gold sea below as the triple Pulse unmade its hold on his existence. His massive armored form emerged from beneath the dying flames, restored to the state he had maintained before Osmonts Pulse had touched him!

Oh!
